公式 dice617kitchen.com。食べログ: ぎょうざ処だいきち、大阪.en: Official dice617kitchen.com. Tabelog: Gyoza Dokoro Daikichi, 2-7-11 Shinsaibashisuji, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Shinsaibashi and Namba stations; Tue–Sat 18:00–2:00 next morning (L.O. 1:30), Sun and holidays 17:00–22:30 (L.O. 22:00); closes when sold out; closed Mondays; no reservations; no cards or e-money; 9 seats (counter); opened 17 June 2016. Reviews (November 2025 – October 2026): an hour's wait at 7 p.m.; kimchi; 4 servings; 5 servings for two; crisp, with pepper and garlic; shikuwasa chuhai; cucumber; small gyoza, 10 to a serving; skins crisp and chewy; good with just vinegar; vinegar-shoyu too; smallish rice; octopus kimchi; ground floor of a mixed building just off Mitsudera-suji; 9 counter seats; the Hanshin game on the radio; sweet-potato soda; the owner runs it single-handed; 2 servings each recommended (not required); about a 30-minute wait; gyoza ¥550; Sapporo Lager (Akaboshi); the owner may be a bit gruff but is efficient.

公式 dining-o.com。食べログ: お好み焼き酒場 O、大阪市中央区難波.en: Official dining-o.com. Reviews (August 2024 – March 2026): open past 10 p.m.; many overseas diners; owner and staff all smiles; pork okonomiyaki; doteyaki; grilled squid legs; crunchy tenkasu; one says a one-drink minimum even at lunch and the taste is ordinary; the bite-size gyoza are good; queues of over 30 minutes; in the basement, queue in front of the door; order while queuing; one dish per person; staff cook it for you; beef-tendon and Kujo-leek salt yakisoba; an hour's wait; okonomiyaki must be ordered all at once at the start, no additions; spicy cucumber; squid and leek with mayo-ponzu; slightly sweet pork okonomiyaki; a basement behind Shochikuza.

公式 dotonbori-kukuru.com。食べログ: たこ家道頓堀くくる.en: Official dotonbori-kukuru.com. Tabelog: Takoya Dotonbori Kukuru Soemoncho, Pigeon Blanc Soemoncho Bldg B1F, 7-18 Soemoncho, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 10 min walk from subway Nippombashi Station; daily 11:00–18:00; no reservations; cards, e-money and QR accepted; 20 seats; no smoking; takeaway available; the stamp card ended 31 March 2023. Reviews (May–September 2026): fluffy and molten; called by number but hard to hear; popular with overseas visitors; large size; light and creamy; along the Dotonbori River; takoyaki and beer set; octopus-shaped containers; Kukuru, which also has shops in the Kanto region; early enough to sit inside; 12 pieces; extra mayo and aonori on request; fluffy outside, molten inside; fairly big octopus; lemon sour from the machine out front; tables at the back; slightly sweet sauce, mayo and bonito flakes; one says service is a little perfunctory with so many tourists.

公式 engespice.com: スパイス居酒屋 煙華香辛、千日前のゆかりビル.en: Official engespice.com: Spice Izakaya Enge Spice, Yukari Bldg 1F, Sennichimae; an ethnic tavern of Chinese × spice; aroma first; over 20 craft gins at any time; signature mouth-watering chicken and iron-pot spiced mapo tofu; 3 courses with 120-minute all-you-can-drink, including a hot-pot course; private hire from 10 on weekdays and 12 at weekends (up to 20); until 0:00 Sun–Thu, holidays and days before holidays, until 5:00 Fri–Sat; special spice curry to finish. Tabelog (shop member): 1-9-22 Sennichimae; 6 min walk from Namba Station exit 15A, 5 min from Nippombashi Station exit 2; last order 30 minutes before closing; irregular closing days (announced on social media); cards accepted; 16 seats (tables 12, counter 4); opened 31 October 2020. Reviews (July–October 2026): lunchtime curry; neck meat and tomato; Akashi octopus red; duck keema with shiso and ume dashi; for the Day of the Ox, eel with basmati rice hitsumabushi-style ¥3,000; a hideaway down an alley; seats a little cramped; featured on TV; staff explain recommended dishes and gins carefully; pickled celery; shrimp mayo; mapo tofu; two-curry plate; 4 gins; salted-kombu cucumber; mouth-watering chicken; shrimp in chili sauce; spicy stir-fried lamb; spring rolls; kimchi; hot-pot courses when it gets cold; courteous service.

公式 fukuchan.co.jp。食べログ: 天地人 日本橋店、大阪市中央区日.en: Official fukuchan.co.jp. Reviews (April–September 2026): Japanese-style ramen ¥880; chicken-bone and tonkotsu shoyu; medium-thin straight noodles; 1 slice chashu; menma; toasted nori; lots of white and green leek; red pickled ginger on the table; 12 seats at an L-shaped counter; sister shop of Fukuchan Ramen and Otokojuku; pricier than the No. 2 shop and no free noodle refills; aimed at overseas visitors to Kuromon Market; mild, for everyone; the tsukemen has a light dipping soup and thinnish noodles; pork-belly chashu chilled and cut thick; no pork rice bowl late at night; a deeply savoury soup and firm noodles; at 2 a.m.; kimchi or menma topping ¥150; canned beer ¥400; one felt the staff lacked enthusiasm.

Reviews (September–October 2026): abura soba B (jumbo, nori, mayo); ticket machine; the jumbo comes in a washbasin-like bowl with 3 portions (officially from 450 g); a slightly sweet sauce and less oil than expected; chili oil and vinegar; lots of condiments; chewy medium-thick noodles; one says few toppings for a jumbo; rice to finish; self-serve cold water, oolong, jasmine tea and detox water; paper aprons; large and extra-large free; garlic, onion, red pickled ginger; soup to finish; a shop at Haneda Airport; spicy miso; cheese set ¥1,000; a flavour like pasta flour; like carbonara; A (egg yolk and Parmesan).

公式 genki-factory.com。食べログ: 煮干しらーめん 玉五郎 黒.en: Official genki-factory.com. Shoes off at the entrance; 7 tables (6 semi-private, 1 private room); a 'gluten-free' tag. FindMeGlutenFree: shop's description 'Gluten-free requires advance booking. Every dish can be made gluten-free'; say so when booking. Reviews by diners with celiac disease: house-made gluten-free tare, shoyu and ponzu; checked again and again at the table; the grill net is changed; once another staff member brought the regular tare (2025); ¥8,800–12,000 per person; premium course ¥12,000; when full, guests are sent to another branch nearby. Manager's reply: there is a vegan menu as well.

公式(matsusaka-projects.com): 松阪牛焼肉M 道頓堀千日.en: Official (matsusaka-projects.com): Matsusaka Beef Yakiniku M Dotonbori Sennichimae, Kamigata Bldg 2F, 1-7-11 Sennichimae, Chuo-ku, Osaka 542-0074, 06-4963-2994; 3 min walk from Namba Walk exit B20; about 100 m east of the Hozenji Yokocho shop; dinner 17:00–23:00 (L.O. 22:30), lunch Sat, Sun and holidays 12:00–15:00 (L.O. 14:30); no closing day (may close occasionally); 14 tables (7 private rooms); a large hall for up to 32; lift; wheelchair accessible; a 'gluten-free' tag; cards and PayPay accepted; Lighthouse Co., Ltd. (authorised member No. 92 of the Matsusaka beef association). FindMeGlutenFree: all the tare is gluten-free (reply from general manager and chef Kenji Urata); staff show you the gluten-free shoyu bottle; non-GF items in a set are swapped; one says nearly everything but the soup is gluten-free; a staff member has celiac disease; reviews August–October 2026.

公式(naki-vegansweets.com): 「誰でも食べられる優しいお菓.en: Official (naki-vegansweets.com): 'gentle sweets anyone can eat', a specialist in vegan and gluten-free sweets made from carefully chosen plant ingredients without eggs, dairy or other animal ingredients: cakes, cookies and baked goods; online shop. FindMeGlutenFree (30 recent ratings): 1-5-5 Namba, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 080-6217-5050; reported as dedicated gluten-free; about 4 seats; takeaway available; tarts ¥1,000 each (September 2026); mango, mixed-berry cheesecake, chocolate pistachio, matcha and white chocolate; cashew cream and almond crust; rice-flour and coconut-oil cookies; Italian espresso; was open 13:00–20:00 (August 2026); served in kimono; the oat milk carried a 'may contain gluten' label, so switched to soy milk (January 2026); one found it unfriendly (April 2026).

公式(ohmicho-inoya)・近江町市場公式(ohmicho-ichiba.en: Official site (ohmicho-inoya), the Omicho Market official site and hot-ishikawa: the shop where Omicho Market's seafood bowl was born (served since around 1989). Over 40 bowls, from under ¥1,000 for locals to high-end for tourists. Famous for the overflowing 'chirashi Omicho extra-large' and the gold-leaf 'Kinpika bowl'. Queue before opening for a 10% early-bird discount. Calls to passers-by in Kanazawa dialect.

公式(roman-gp.com、株式会社ROMAN TALE): 茶屋しずく、鹿.en: Official (roman-gp.com, ROMAN TALE Co., Ltd.): Chaya Shizuku, a specialist in sweets made with organic matcha grown on the group's farm in Kagoshima Prefecture; the signature 'Matcha Fukashi Paun' freshly steamed from the seiro, lightly sweet, chewy, fluffy and light, made gluten-free without wheat flour; a rare organic matcha hardly grown anywhere in Japan; Namba shop 3-2-14 Namba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; matcha × pistachio fair (19 October). Independent from Okayama Food Service Co., Ltd. FindMeGlutenFree: gluten-free menu; not dedicated gluten-free; gluten-free cones (October 2026); steamed matcha cake; matcha latte (soy milk); matcha confirmed gluten-free, no oat milk (September 2026); soft-serve; one visitor came every day. Opening hours not found.

公式(spys-oasis.com): スパイスオアシス、〒542-0076 大.en: Official (spys-oasis.com): Spys Oasis, 1-5-8 Namba, Chuo-ku, Osaka 542-0076, 06-6211-5115; medicinal spice curries by a yakuzen meister with gluten-free drinks and food; food and medicine from one source; three in one (yellow: soy-milk onion-tomato ginger chicken breast; black: black-sesame red-miso pork hijiki keema; green: mackerel and lotus-root green popeye); low-carb, low-GL basmati rice and 15-grain rice; Simple ¥1,600, Standard ¥2,000, Gorgeous ¥3,180, Luxury ¥3,880; vegan & gluten-free curries (root vegetables; soy mince with red-pepper salsa; pumpkin, banana, mango, corn, chickpeas; ¥1,700 each, 2 kinds ¥1,800, 3 kinds ¥1,900); toppings ¥200 each; roast chicken leg ¥1,280; 'we don't use gluten'; Mon–Wed and Fri–Sat lunch 11:30–15:00 and bar 18:00–24:00 (one-drink minimum), Sun and holidays 11:30–15:00 and 17:00–22:00; closed Thursdays; no phone reservations, online booking. Tabelog: 14 seats (ground-floor counter 7, 2nd-floor tables 7); allergen information available; vegan and gluten-free menu; opened 4 February 2023.

公式(urc.jp): らーめん亀王 道頓堀店、大阪市中央区道頓堀2-2-17.en: Official (urc.jp): Ramen Kiou Dotonbori, Chubee Bldg 1F, 2-2-17 Dotonbori, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 06-6484-0090; weekdays and holidays 11:30–2:00 next morning (L.O. 1:30), Fri, Sat and days before holidays 11:30–4:00 next morning (L.O. 3:30); open every day of the year; thick chashu and piping-hot gyoza; the original Kyushu abura soba. Tabelog: 15 seats (counter 8, tables 7); Mon–Thu 11:00–2:30 next morning, Fri, Sat, Sun and days before holidays 11:00–4:30 next morning; no cards; smoking allowed; 'the strongest toro-chashu in Kansai'. Reviews (October 2025 – August 2026): the tomato ramen is like a soup pasta; Kyushu ramen; melting chashu; ordinary noodles; queues of nothing but overseas travellers; red-miso chashu-men; extra-thin Hakata-style noodles; multilingual menu; all staff from overseas except the manager; standard tonkotsu; fatty chashu; tomato ramen and tomato tsukemen; popular in Korea; Kiou ramen (salt tonkotsu).

公式(wholisticretreat.life): W RETREAT CAF.en: Official (wholisticretreat.life): W RETREAT CAFE, Luster On Shinsaibashi Bldg 10F, 4-5-8 Minamisenba, Chuo-ku, Osaka 542-0081, 06-6755-8347; Shinsaibashi Station exit 2 and Crysta Nagahori north stairs 11; a gut-health cafe supervised by the beauty clinic 'W CLINIC'; ALL ORGANIC; a plant-based vegan lunch with no meat, seafood, eggs or dairy at all; October's monthly 'VEGAN gozen' ¥3,000 (9 small dishes of organic vegetables, mushroom kamameshi, autumn-vegetable miso soup, organic daikon pickles); organic seasonal-vegetable salad ¥1,650; dinner-only menu; a calendar of opening days; reservations via the official LINE; #glutenfree tag. FindMeGlutenFree: reported as dedicated gluten-free; pizza, pasta (bolognese), bread, açaí bowl, desserts; one diner struggled with online ordering (June 2026); hard to find on the 10th floor.

公式(yoyaku-abenohub.com): ABENO HUB、大阪市中央.en: Official (yoyaku-abenohub.com): ABENO HUB, Nakatani Bldg 1F, 2-3-26 Namba, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 06-6211-0575; 3–8 min walk from the Namba stations; Tue–Fri 17:00–23:00, Sat 14:00–23:00 (another section says Sat from 17:00); L.O. food 22:00, drinks 22:30; closed Mondays and Sundays; reservations accepted (bookings via the site take priority); 40 seats (counter 5, 7 tables); semi-private rooms; private hire possible; cards, e-money and QR payment accepted; separate smoking (smoking allowed on the outdoor terrace); average ¥3,000–3,999. Gluten-free okonomiyaki from 100% domestic Koshihikari rice flour; yakisoba with Akitakomachi rice-flour noodles; cooked in olive oil; vegetable-based sauce; British roots; organic wine; British organic tea. FindMeGlutenFree: not dedicated gluten-free; the gyoza is wheat and on the same griddle (October 2026); okonomiyaki ¥1,100; explained the fryer; ordering by app; an English-speaking chef-owner; gluten-free potato salad and pudding; no queue.

公式(アラカワフードサービス): 花丸軒 難波・法善寺店、〒542-0076 大.en: Official (Arakawa Food Service): Hanamaruken Namba Hozenji, 1-2-1 Namba, Chuo-ku, Osaka 542-0076, 06-6213-0131; open 24 hours, every day of the year; 5 min walk from subway Namba, Kintetsu/Hanshin Osaka-Namba and Nippombashi stations; 17 seats (counter 15, tables 2); completely non-smoking; cards and e-money accepted; ramen to its own carefully considered recipe; fried rice and gyoza popular too. Tabelog: lists closure over New Year. 2026 reviews: a 24-hour shop visited for years; the 2nd-floor toilet has narrow stairs; ticket machine taking many payment types; many inbound tourists; new garlic tonkotsu ramen (April); tonkotsu-shoyu base; rich but not heavy; medium-thin noodles; melting chashu; Hanamaruken after the sauna at Amza; toro-kotsu ramen (two big pieces of pork); nori, menma, naruto, leek; free kimchi; white rice; shorter queues now; champon; lighter than before; not piping hot; fried rice.

公式Instagram habana_namba。食べログ: 葉花、大阪市中央区.en: Official Instagram habana_namba. Tabelog: Havana, 1-5-7 Namba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3 min from Namba Station; Mon–Fri and days before holidays 16:00–23:15, Sat 15:00–23:15, Sun and holidays 15:00–22:15; irregular closing days; reservations accepted; cards and PayPay accepted, no e-money; 2nd-floor seats ¥330; 20 seats (ground-floor standing for 18, 20 seats on the 2nd floor); opened 23 December 2022; Tachinomi Hyakumeiten 2025; a renovated old building with beams and earthen walls; daily obanzai on big platters. October 2026 reviews: mega highball; 6-starter platter; crab-miso cream croquettes; plain omelette; black-pepper highball; potato salad on the 2nd floor; sanma confit with aubergine purée; rare wild boar with red-wine sauce; sashimi platter ¥600; 3 vegetable starters ¥450; spicy pork shumai with coriander, 2 for ¥430; fig, prosciutto and ricotta ¥500; black-tea and mixed-berry sour ¥550; grated-peach Bellini ¥600; mobile ordering on the 2nd floor; neck meat with black shichimi ¥380; carbonara-style pasta salad ¥400; smoked chikuwa with mayo ¥380; corn and mitsuba fried dumplings ¥450; Okinawan-style marinated squid guts ¥380; a back alley leading to Hozenji; self-serve bottled-beer fridge; many regulars.

公式X menno_yoji3rd。食べログ: 麺のようじ、大阪市中央区高津2-.en: Official X menno_yoji3rd. Tabelog: Men no Youji, Okoshi Bldg 1F, 2-1-2 Kozu, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 6–8 min walk from Nippombashi Station exit 7; daily 11:30–14:40 (L.O. 14:20) and 18:00–21:00 (L.O. 20:30); no cards, e-money or QR; 8 seats (counter 4, tables 4); opened 9 May 2013, renamed and renewed 28 January 2014; Ramen Hyakumeiten (WEST 2018–2020, OSAKA 2023–2025). Reviews (September–October 2026): a regular who keeps coming back (over 100 visits); tori-paitan ramen and stone-grilled cheese omurice; thick chicken tsukemen ¥1,300 and large ¥150; ticket machine outside; extra-thick flat straight noodles; a bubbling chicken-shoyu dipping soup; menu (chicken-bonito premium salt, chicken-bonito premium shoyu, thick chicken tsukemen, chicken-bonito abura soba, chicken salt, Shirakawa-style tsukemen, Shirakawa-style ramen, stone-grilled omurice, stone-grilled fried rice); limited Youji ramen ¥1,100; medium-thick wavy noodles; two staff; limited tori paitan (salt base); Teigaku noodles; chicken-bonito premium salt ¥1,000 and rare chashu rice bowl ¥350; 2 kinds of chashu; plenty of yuzu; shoyu ramen and chashu rice bowl; a wall of autographs; low-temperature chashu and chicken-thigh chashu; chicken-thigh chashu rice bowl ¥400; a salt packed with chicken umami.

公式food.htmlはうなぎ湯葉を『昭和30年代に考案し、ずっと作り続けている.en: The official food.html says unagi yuba (mock eel of tofu skin) is 'a Konokonbou speciality devised in the 1950s and made ever since', that the cooking is named 'Muryoju' (Infinite Life), and that hōhan is a rice dish to finish with shojin dashi, eaten at Zenkoji's New Year 'Dōdōji' ceremony. Go! NAGANO (id20052) says serious shojin cuisine began about 50 years ago, with Konokonbou leading the way; the then head priest's wife set the course, and today 若麻績妙子 carries on the flavours.

公式tenpoページで安曇野スワンガーデン内の本店、一年中炭火の囲炉裏で購入した.en: The official tenpo page confirms the main shop in Swan Garden Azumino, the experience of grilling the oyaki you buy at a charcoal irori hearth all year round, always more than 20 kinds and over 40 a year, dough mixed with rice flour or sixteen grains, and the tenant shop inside Takahashi Shoten on Zenkoji Nakamise.

公式「北野家の歴史」ページより、明治33年に初代七郎右衛門が保科で創業、四代続く.en: From the official 'History of Kitanoya' page: founded in Meiji 33 (1900) in Hoshina by the first-generation 七郎右衛門, a long-established shop of four generations. The kaeshi has been kept in two heirloom jars for over 100 years; frigate-mackerel and small bonito flakes are shaved in-house 3–4 times a month, taking over two hours. A food blog (September 2024) confirms the texture of a limited 10-a-day 100% buckwheat soba of Togakushi buckwheat stone-milled in Shinano-machi.

公式『KOJI IDA』ページとJR東海の記事で、代表焙煎士は井田浩司、2013.en: The official 'KOJI IDA' page and a JR Central article confirm head roaster Koji Ida, CQI-certified Q Grader in 2013, winner of JCRC2018. Built on the kissaten 'ROCOCO' founded in 1974, it became a specialty-coffee shop in 2010. It serves croissants of Nara-grown wheat and the 'Rokumei Blend'.

公式『会社概要』に代表者『飯田紗央里』、2017年2月開業・2019年10月法人.en: The official 'company profile' states the representative, 飯田紗央里 (Iida Saori), opening in February 2017 and incorporation in October 2019. A Web-Komachi article describes the background (product development at a Tokyo café and research into vegan diets and food allergies as the starting point) and the move from Miwa, Nagano City to in front of Nagano Station (15 January 2022). Butter-sandwich flavours confirmed include seasonal fruit such as Kyoho grape. Some details, such as hometown, are unknown.

公式サイト nanakoshi.com は創業50年以上・鳥羽の名物（伊勢うどん.en: The official site nanakoshi.com says the shop has been going for over 50 years and serves Toba specialities such as Ise udon. The Ise-Shima tourism association (iseshima-kanko.jp) lists chewy, thick Ise udon, house-made udon, tekone-zushi and turban shells grilled in the shell. A personal blog (sirokuroomochi, Golden Week 2025) confirms a family business, a tamari-soy dashi sauce handed down through the generations, Ise udon boiled for about 40 minutes, and a tekone-zushi set (about ¥1,540).

公式サイト(sanyasou.co.jp)は農家のお母さんたちが地元野菜で一つ一.en: The official site (sanyasou.co.jp) says its mainstay is oyaki hand-made one by one by farming mothers with local vegetables, and that it also sells suiton, oden and amazake. Spicy radish and nozawana oyaki are confirmed. JA operation, founding year, additive-free and a direct-sales model are not stated, so those lines were removed or softened. The anecdotes of seasonal changes (jalan) and the thoughtful cold water (55anz) were confirmed in the cited sources.

公式サイト: すするか、すすらんか。は麻婆豆腐ラーメン専門店。オーダーメイドで調.en: Official site: Susuruka, Susuranka. is a mapo-tofu ramen specialist. Mapo tofu cooked to order is poured over smooth, chewy medium-thick noodles, a little different from ordinary mapo noodles. Naramachi main shop (28-34 Minamishirotocho, Nara; 11:00–15:00 and 18:00–21:00; closed Tuesdays). Tabelog: Susuruka, Susuranka. Shinsaibashi, Daiichi KS Bldg B1F, 1-15-22 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 06-7634-7598; no reservations; Mon–Thu and days before and after holidays 11:00–15:00 (L.O. 14:30) and 18:00–23:00 (L.O. 22:30), Fri–Sun 11:00–15:00 and 18:00–4:00 next morning; cards, e-money and QR payment accepted; 26 seats; no smoking; wheelchair accessible; vegetarian and halal menus (ask staff). 2026 reviews (July–October): October-only hearty seafood meat-miso maze-soba ¥1,300 (meat miso, egg yolk, nira, bean sprouts, fish powder, fried onion, shredded nori, garlic on the side, thick chewy noodles); mackerel-dashi rice ¥300; July-only mega-garlic mapo-tofu ramen ¥1,500; summer-only cold basil mapo-tofu ramen; the mapo tofu is the Naramachi main shop's; mapo rice bowl; yu lin chicken; teriyaki rice bowl; a calm counter; a late-night last stop; one says it was quiet on a Friday lunchtime and staff didn't come unless called.

公式サイト: ハラールレストラン、ハラール和牛、ディナーコース、毎週木曜定休、心.en: Official site: halal restaurant, halal wagyu, dinner courses, closed every Thursday, Shinsaibashi Station exits 4 and 5. Tabelog: ALI'S KITCHEN, Tres Bldg B1F, 1-10-12 Shinsaibashisuji, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 06-4708-5745; reservations accepted; Mon–Wed and Fri–Sun 11:00–15:00 (lunch 11:00–14:30) and 17:00–22:00; closed Thursdays (for now); cards accepted, no e-money or QR; 32 seats; no smoking; vegetarian and halal menus; Hyakumeiten (Curry WEST 2019 and 2020, Asian & Ethnic WEST 2022–2024). October 2026 reviews: chicken biryani ¥1,600; spicy curry ¥1,800 (bone-in meat); potato samosa ¥800; baingan aloo (aubergine and potato curry) ¥1,200; biryani set ¥1,000 (with drink, large portion); tandoori chicken ¥250 a piece; falafel set ¥2,000 (chickpea croquettes, hummus, Arab pickles, bread); the lunch chicken and vegetable curries are mild; naan; lassi; mixed kebab; hummus shawarma; palak paneer; many overseas diners; talk of halal certification.

公式サイト: 堀江発酵堂、からだが喜ぶ発酵料理、自然のちからが活きた発酵食、無農.en: Official site: Horie Hakkodo; fermented dishes your body will thank you for; fermented food alive with the power of nature; pesticide-free, additive-free ingredients with hand-made seasonings and traditionally made seasonings (price-change notice, February 2023); open 11:00–19:00; no closing day. Tabelog: 1-15-17 Minami-Horie, Nishi-ku, Osaka, 06-6541-8111; reservations accepted; daily 11:00–19:00; cards AMEX only; QR (PayPay, d-barai) accepted; no smoking; opened 12 November 2021. 2026 reviews (June–October): Orange Street; roomy seats; fermented karaage set meal (crisp outside, moist inside); 5 small side dishes; ordering by touch panel; healthy fermented-vegetable set meal (no meat, fragrant miso soup, fermented-enzyme brown rice); fermented monkey-banana shake and seasonal fermented-enzyme juice; fried mackerel set meal; items to take home too; busy at lunch.

公式サイトおよびメニューは日本語のみ。英語対応の記載なし。電話予約のみのため、日.en: The official site and menu are Japanese only. No mention of English. Phone booking only, so Japanese or an interpreter is needed.

公式サイトが創業約28年・県外からも来客、伊勢湾の魚介を提供と記載。メニューペー.en: The official site says the shop has been going about 28 years, draws customers from outside the prefecture and serves Ise Bay seafood. The menu page confirms a seafood bowl at ¥2,650 (salted salmon and an original sauce under the rice), a sashimi set (8 kinds of seasonal sashimi, the house best) and a wild kuruma prawn fry set.

公式サイトで瀬下努(1977年長野県生)・東京の調理師学校後オテル・ドゥ・ミクニ.en: The official site confirms Tsutomu Seshimo (born 1977 in Nagano Prefecture); after cooking school in Tokyo, 12 years at Hôtel de Mikuni; head chef in Izu and at Sankara in Yakushima; opened December 2016; the name means 'encounter'. Hitosara confirms a renovated 150-year-old house, 18 seats, and a garden of home-grown herbs and flowers.

公式サイトとTabelogで、近江町いちば館2階、朝の市場仕入れ、名物『海の宝石.en: The official site and Tabelog confirm: 2nd floor of Omicho Ichiba-kan; bought at the morning market; the famous 'jewel box of the sea' seafood hitsumabushi (three ways: sesame sauce → sea urchin and condiments → dashi chazuke); an all-crab course; blackthroat-seaperch dishes.

公式サイトとcorezoで、元魚屋の店主が長年の技術で素材の旨みを引き出す、近江.en: The official site and corezo confirm: an owner, a former fishmonger, who draws out the ingredients' flavour with long-practised skill; buys from Yamaka Suisan in Omicho Market; seafood bowls of tuna, crab, yellowtail, blackthroat seaperch, salmon roe and sea urchin (on plain Ishikawa Koshihikari, not vinegared rice); sashimi, jibuni, Kaga-vegetable tempura.

公式サイトとfood-japonで、店主平田賢太郎、2015年8月8日片町開業、.en: The official site and food-japon confirm: owner Hirata Kentaro; opened in Katamachi on 8 August 2015; the name means 'building a circle'; a branch in Kanazawa Station's Anto; 'drinkable dashi' of Rishiri kombu, several kinds of shaved fish, Ono soy sauce and Noto salt; house-made chikuwa, hanpen and burdock tempura; creations such as egg topped with salmon roe, fried pork, cod-roe oden and beef-tendon mapo.

公式サイトとぐるなび・gorpで確認：浜の味処 天びん屋グループ(本店・一番街店.en: Confirmed on the official site, Gurunavi and gorp: the Hama no Ajidokoro Tenbinya group (main shop, Ichiban-gai shop, Amiyaki); the ama diver's kamameshi is a certified Toba local bento; a seafood bowl of six kinds plus sea urchin and salmon roe; Ise udon and tekone-zushi.

公式サイトとたびいろで、明治44年（1911）創業、『和菓子の基本は美味しい餡づ.en: The official site and Tabiiro confirm: founded Meiji 44 (1911); the creed 'the foundation of wagashi is making delicious bean paste'; the famous fukusa mochi and the classic Kanazawa souvenir brown-sugar fukusa mochi; gold-leaf azuki soft serve only at the main shop; Japanese chestnut Mont Blanc; the famous Kakiho (kinako and black sesame); the dry sweet wari-gori.

公式サイトとブログ・検索で確認：2013年12月30日創業、1階物販＋2階カフェ.en: Confirmed on the official site, blogs and searches: founded 30 December 2013; shop on the first floor and café on the second; house-roasted coffee, seafood curry and house-made waffles. Corrected: what architect 藤原徹平 designed is Hinoyama Lab (the Senkiraku project), opened in 2023, not the second floor of the main shop.

公式サイトとメニューで確認：鳥羽一番街3階・駅隣接、伊勢うどん、鳥羽産しらす釜玉.en: Confirmed on the official site and menu: third floor of Toba Ichiban-gai, next to the station; Ise udon, Toba whitebait kamatama udon, large shrimp tempura, oysters and fresh aosa (winter), sudachi (summer), akamoku seaweed, Matsusaka beef. Corrected あおさ to aosa.

公式サイトと伊勢志摩観光ナビで確認：昭和51年(1976)創業、鳥羽駅隣接の鳥羽.en: Confirmed on the official site and the Ise-Shima tourism navigator: founded 1976 (Shōwa 51); a classic coffee shop inside Toba Ichiban-gai next to Toba Station; famous for the Tobager (octopus, mayo and nut topping, about ¥780), local pasta and curry.

公式サイトと現地レポートによれば、ミネルヴァは鳥羽駅前・鳥羽一番街1階のジェラー.en: According to the official site and on-site reports, Minerva is a gelato shop on the first floor of Toba Ichiban-gai in front of Toba Station, with the slogan 'Delivered fresh from the factory' (made in Futami, Ise City). It uses milk from Okoppe, Hokkaido, and its signature is the Pearl Latte (milk gelato with pearl powder, said to be good for the skin). It has Ise-Shima local flavours such as Iwato salt, Ise tea and kinko sweet potato.

公式サイトと食べログによれば、三条坊はJR奈良駅直結のビエラ奈良1階で2010年.en: According to the official site and Tabelog, Sanjobo opened in October 2010 on the first floor of Viera Nara, connected to JR Nara Station, with about 29 seats. Curry udon, beef bowls and grated-yam udon of Nara's brand beef 'Yamato beef', and 'Stamina-ra udon', Nara's stamina ramen made as udon, are the specialities. Udon, soba and drinks.

公式サイトと鳥羽市観光協会で確認：名物ガンガン焼き(浦村産牡蠣・通年提供・2〜3.en: Confirmed on the official site and the Toba tourism association: the signature gangan-yaki (Uramura oysters, served all year, flash-frozen at −60 °C in February–March), Ise chicken, finest Matsusaka beef and a special miso sauce. Grade A4 is not in the sources, so changed to 'finest'.

公式サイトに全品目のアレルゲン一覧ページが整備されており、原材料を事前に確認でき.en: The official site has an allergen list page for every product, so you can check the ingredients beforehand.

公式サイトは『創業50余年 地元に愛される老舗』とうたう近江町市場の回転寿司。U.en: The official site bills it as 'a long-established shop loved locally for over 50 years': conveyor-belt sushi in Omicho Market. A U-shaped counter (about 20–25 seats). Reopened after renovation on 17 June 2024. The master buys and picks the fish personally every morning. Mainly local fish (white shrimp, sweet shrimp, kombu-cured fish and more). Orders on paper slips.

公式サイト・Jalan・Tabelog が、約140年の歴史をもつ湯田中温泉の源.en: The official site, Jalan and Tabelog confirm a ryokan with about 140 years of history in Yudanaka Onsen, with free-flowing hot-spring water (4 sources, 2 open-air baths), serving local kaiseki by the head chef. No gluten-free handling is published; only individual consultation in advance.

公式サイト・ヒトサラで、片町3階の金沢おでん・おばんざい酒場、車麩や赤巻き入りの.en: The official site and Hitosara confirm: a Kanazawa oden and obanzai tavern on a third floor in Katamachi; Kanazawa oden with kurumabu and akamaki; daily obanzai; tea-shochu highballs (green tea, jasmine, etc.); a counter that welcomes solo guests; late-night bar hours. Fried chicken and mapo tofu were not confirmed, so changed to general wording.

公式サイト・ブログで確認：2017年7月開店、昭和通りの元家具店を改装、シェフは.en: Confirmed on the official site and blogs: opened July 2017 in a converted former furniture shop on Shōwa-dōri; the chef trained in Canada and New York, then worked at a Nagano hotel; house-made focaccia of soy milk and mixed grains; game (venison, boar); deli plates; a sign saying 'babies' crying welcome'.

公式サイト・奈良ランチ・奈良グルメ図鑑で、三条町の築120年以上の町家を改装した.en: The official site, Nara Lunch and the Nara Gourmet Guide confirm a café in a renovated townhouse over 120 years old in Sanjo-cho. It uses local ingredients, such as stewed hamburgs of Yamato beef and Yamato pork, hamburgs in thick sauce, hojicha-smoked loin and lattes of Yagyū-grown Yamato tea, and welcomes families with tatami seating, deer motifs and a nursing room. The opening year could not be confirmed in any source.

公式サイト等によると、鳥羽志摩農協（JA）と鳥羽磯部漁協（JF）が共同設立した鳥.en: According to the official site and others, a farm-and-sea direct market, rare even nationally, run by the Toba Marche LLP, set up jointly by the Toba-Shima agricultural co-op (JA) and the Toba-Isobe fisheries co-op (JF). About 2 minutes' walk from Toba Station. A direct-sales shop of about 310 m² and a local-produce restaurant under one roof. From 1 February 2025 it switched from an all-you-can-eat buffet to 'Toba meshi' of local ingredients (local-fish sashimi, one plate per person; tekone-zushi; local-fish carpaccio; kakiage, etc.). Red Pearl strawberry soft serve is its speciality.

公式サイト（about）で、創業者は大工の棟梁だった田中徳松、妻ヨシ、孫の修司と.en: The official site (about) confirms that the founder 田中徳松, a master carpenter, the founder's wife ヨシ, and the couple's grandson 修司 with 修司's wife 孝 made persimmon-leaf sushi the house speciality; the company was set up in 1973; and in 1979 it was presented to the Emperor and Empress Shōwa through the abbess of Chūgūji.

公式サイト（about）は2021年6月22日開業、ミシュランシェフとのタイアッ.en: The official site (about) confirms the opening on 22 June 2021, "Zeimi" from a tie-up with a Michelin-starred chef, and domestic real bracken starch. A round-up article records the TV appearance and the expansion to 12 shops nationwide.

公式サイト（jimdo）は1998年創業、西二階町、目の前で揚げて素早く提供する.en: The official site (jimdo) records: founded 1998; Nishi-Nikaimachi; a policy of frying in front of you and serving quickly; a kushikatsu set lunch. The ma8coro blog tells the story that the name comes from an Osaka shop called Moguraya (a favourite of the previous owner's partner), mentions rabbit-pattern plates, and a ¥800 lunch of 7 skewers. Tabelog confirms it as a kushiage shop in Nishi-Nikaimachi.

公式サイト（owst）confirms 堀川町5-9、金沢駅東口徒歩3分、白ミッ.en: The official site (owst) confirms 5-9 Horikawa-cho, 3 minutes' walk from Kanazawa Station east exit; white mix / red mix ¥748, kopchang ¥825, pork belly ¥528; a starter of heaped cabbage; house-made sauce; its place as a renowned shop tucked down a back alley.

公式サイト（owst）で、南町の立地、伝助穴子（漁獲の数％の希少穴子）を刺身・焼.en: The official site (owst) confirms: the Minami-cho location; Densuke conger eel (a rare eel, a few percent of the catch) served as sashimi, grilled and as hitsumabushi; Himeji lotus root and Himeji oden; local sake such as Tatsuriki and Yaegaki; a modern Japanese interior described as "another world".

公式サイト：明治8年（1875）創業、お茶一筋約150年、二階町66、喫茶「存外.en: Official site: founded in 1875 (Meiji 8); about 150 years devoted to tea; Nikaimachi 66; the café "Zongai"; the green soft serve, loved for over 50 years. KissPress: matcha and wagashi set ¥500 (tax included); daily wagashi from local confectioners (Kineya and others); the green soft serve was developed jointly by several tea shops; choose your favourite tea bowl from around Japan. visit-himeji: choose a bowl and enjoy freshly whisked tea casually at table seats. The number of seats is not stated, so it is not given.

公式ブログ ameblo.jp/gaten8。食べログ(店舗会員): 麺屋ガテン.en: Official blog ameblo.jp/gaten8. Tabelog (shop member): Menya Gaten Z, 1-1-5 Nipponbashi-nishi, Naniwa-ku, Osaka; on Otaroad; 5 min walk from Nankai Namba and Ebisucho stations; last entry weekdays lunch 15:00 and dinner 21:30, weekends and holidays lunch 15:45 and dinner 22:00; open every day of the year (except New Year); no cards, e-money or QR; opened 24 October 2017. Reviews (February–June 2026): Taiwan MAZE soba ¥1,150; extra garlic and fat; thick flat noodles; minced meat, nira, nori, fish powder, egg yolk; black pepper, shichimi, Sichuan pepper, chili oil, vinegar and ramen sauce on the table; point card and gacha; MAZE soba (shoyu) 300 g noodles; amounts of noodles, vegetables, garlic and fat adjusted free; unlimited kimchi; curry maze-soba; restrained heat; mentaiko from the ¥100 gacha; counter only; cash ticket machine; about 10 minutes until served; strong garlic; soupless salt ramen with yuzu; a Namba shop too.

公式ブログ jouroku.blog.fc2.com。食べログ: 麺屋 丈六 な.en: Official blog jouroku.blog.fc2.com. Tabelog: Menya Joroku Namba, 6-16 Namba Sennichimae, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 6 min walk from subway Nippombashi Station exit 5; Mon, Tue and Thu–Sun 11:30–15:00 and 18:00–21:00; closed Wednesdays; on the first Sunday of each month 7:00–10:00 and 11:30–15:00 with no evening service; temporary closures on the blog; no reservations; no cards, e-money or QR; 7 seats (counter); no smoking; Tabelog 3.73; Ramen Hyakumeiten 2017–2025; opened 21 December 2008 on the 2nd floor of Tempozan Marketplace, moved to Namba 23 December 2010, renamed 'Menya Joroku' 1 March 2015. October 2026 reviews: shrimp salt ramen (gentle depth of niboshi, sakura shrimp); anniversary-only garlic ramen; a soup that looks jet black but isn't salty; medium-thick noodles; chuka soba small; traditional Osaka ramen; chuka soba small ¥900; 4 min walk from NGK; a dark shoyu-coloured soup with black pepper; not as heavy as it looks; medium-thick straight noodles; thin-sliced chashu; leek; menma; one from Hokkaido found the shoyu strong; Takaida-style chuka soba; an almost black soup; seasoned egg; a narrow alley; a queue and a waiting area; haya-zushi ¥200 (wrapped in a Wakayama leaf); chuka soba regular ¥1,000.

公式ページ(nanbavim.biz-option.com): 「【公式】Glu.en: Official page (nanbavim.biz-option.com): '[Official] Gluten-Free Vegan OKONOMIYAKI Vim', with only a phone number and links to Instagram and HappyCow. FindMeGlutenFree: 1-3-13 Namba, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 06-4963-3034, reported as dedicated gluten-free. Reviews by diners with celiac disease (2026): a ground-floor counter and one table upstairs, about 6 seats; king oyster mushrooms, grilled pasta, okonomiyaki, pork-belly okonomiyaki, grilled scallops, karaage, fried tofu and rice balls, Kirin gluten-free beer; reservation essential (online booking needs a Japanese phone number); opens 17:00 and is full before opening; one says closed Thursdays; closed an hour early; no entry under 18; one dish and one drink per person; small portions and pricey; a sister shop nearby; reports conflict between all-vegetarian and serving meat and seafood.

公式・web-komachi・naganogourmetで確認：諏訪町の路地裏、.en: Confirmed on the official site, web-komachi and naganogourmet: in a back alley of Suwa-machi, marked by a blue door; about 10 seats (full with 6–7 people); house-made bread of Japanese wheat and Hoshino natural yeast; hand-made pudding; ingredients kind to the body; booking by Instagram DM recommended; Kurashi no Techo on the counter. Opened around 2011.

公式会社概要（2001年5月設立・代表向井昭博・2004年ネット通販・2011年.en: Confirmed by the official company profile (founded May 2001; representative 向井昭博; online sales from 2004; Himeji Castle shop March 2011; a spirit of challenge that does not fear failure; Harima-nada) and searches (Harima White Pearl = virgin oysters that have never spawned, farmed at Ieshima, with little harshness or bitterness). The MAFF Kinki Regional Agricultural Administration Office inbound case-study URL is official but now returns 403, so its text could not be re-fetched.

公式店舗ページで、料理長は金澤忍、みつ川の味と技を継承、金沢では珍しい赤酢のシャ.en: The official shop page confirms: head chef Kanazawa Shinobu, carrying on the flavours and skill of Mitsukawa; red-vinegar sushi rice, rare in Kanazawa; buying from Omicho and Kanazawa Port; the famous blackthroat-seaperch hand roll; original local sake; Michelin Bib Gourmand 2016.

公式（haru-nara.com）とcoolnaraで、代表は中林大樹、2011.en: The official site (haru-nara.com) and coolnara confirm: owner 中林大樹; opened October 2011; a Naramachi townhouse over 120 years old (tatami room facing the garden). Twice-ground hamburg on an iron plate with demi-glace, head-on fried shrimp you can eat whole, Yamato beef rice bowl, pudding of Uemura Bokujo milk, tartar sauce with Narazuke.

公式（kudzu.co.jp）およびintojapanwarakuで、井上天極堂.en: The official site (kudzu.co.jp) and intojapanwaraku confirm Inoue Tengyokudo, founded in 1870 (Meiji 3), makes Yoshino pure kuzu by the 'Yoshino-sarashi' method dating from the late Edo period. Kuzu mochi is made after ordering and served in about 10 minutes (cold outside, warm inside); also kuzu noodles, kuzu-yu and kuzu udon; the main shop is on the former site of Tōdaiji's west great gate.

公式（machishin）はまちづくり振興機構運営、大手門駐車場内・本町68、喫.en: The official site (machishin) confirms: run by the Urban Development Promotion Organization; inside the Otemon car park, Honmachi 68; café (coffee, cappuccino, etc.); a Yamazaki convenience corner; free wheelchair loans; Himeji Castle goods. The Himeji tourism site lists almond toast ¥458 and rice-koji amazake ¥356.

公式（owst）：兵庫県姫路市立町71、播磨うまいもん居酒屋、穴子（焼き1,08.en: Official site (owst): Tatemachi 71, Himeji, Hyogo; an izakaya of Harima local food; conger eel (grilled ¥1,080 / tempura ¥880 / chazuke ¥690); Himeji oden (ginger soy sauce); the homemade shrimp shumai (¥470) is popular. Tabelog: sourced from Murotsu and Boze ports and contract farmers; 20 seats. ma8coro: the chef-owner recommends the shumai. ameblo: covered in celebrity autographs.

刺身そのものは基本的に無添加・小麦不使用で提供されることが多く、醤油を避ければ選.en: Sashimi itself is often served with no additives or wheat, so there may be items you can choose if you avoid the soy sauce.

刺身・牛肉・焼き魚・海老天ぷらなど動物性食材を同一厨房で扱うため、植物性料理との.en: Sashimi, beef, grilled fish and shrimp tempura are handled in the same kitchen, so plant dishes risk contact. No mention of dedicated vegan cooking equipment.

創業82年で姫路の老舗として行列ができる店と紹介され、過去4店舗から現在1店舗に.en: Introduced as an 82-year-old Himeji institution with queues, and the story of consolidating from four shops to one is recorded.

創業82年以上の姫路の老舗とんかつ店。店名「赤心」は、創業者の曽祖父が敬慕した勝.en: A long-established Himeji tonkatsu shop, over 82 years old. The name "Sekishin" is said to come from words of Katsu Kaishu, whom the founder's great-grandfather admired, and means "a sincere heart". It once had four shops in Himeji but now runs only the main shop. It has appeared on TV and in other media several times.

創業以来『一客一亭』のおもてなしを旨とし、客をもてなす料亭旅館としての文化の継承.en: Since its founding it has held to 'one guest, one pavilion' hospitality, with the mission of carrying on and spreading the culture of a ryotei inn that entertains guests.

創業明治初年.en: founded in the first year of Meiji (about 1868)

創業明治初年より鳥羽港にて、すし販売を続けております。地産地消をめざし、煮付けは.en: Since our founding in the first year of Meiji we have sold sushi at Toba Port. We aim for local production for local consumption, and our simmered dishes are house-made.

創業昭和11年（片町）の金沢おでん老舗。創業者が東京でのタクシー運転手時代に馴染.en: A long-established Kanazawa oden shop (Katamachi) founded in Shōwa 11 (1936). The founder used, and has topped up ever since, the dark Kanto-style broth grown familiar while driving a taxi in Tokyo. Melting beef tendon with the house's secret ginger miso, which also goes on daikon and fish balls. Crab 'face' (November–December), whelk, kurumabu, akamaki, Kaga vegetables, dote-yaki and curry oden too. Ivy-covered front and red lantern with Shōwa charm.

加賀の郷土料理に京都の懐石の手法を取り入れた会席料理。山海の幸をふんだんに用いた.en: Kaiseki that brings Kyoto kaiseki techniques to Kaga local cuisine: multi-course meals generous with the bounty of mountain and sea, served in tatami rooms and annexes overlooking the garden.

厚さ5cmを超えるニューヨークスタイルの極厚スコーン。 定番のプレーンスコーンは.en: Extra-thick New York-style scones over 5 cm tall. The standard plain scone, a best-seller, puts the aroma and flavour of Yotsuba cultured butter up front ("Buttery Plain Scone", ¥300). About 20 kinds of scone change daily.

参道沿いの観光地にあり指さし注文は可能だが、メニュー・スタッフ対応は日本語のみ。.en: On a tourist street along the temple approach; pointing to order works, but the menu and staff are Japanese only.

古民家の趣を活かした猫モチーフのインテリアと温かい照明が「おばあちゃんの家」のよ.en: Several bloggers say the cat-themed interior and warm lighting, set off by the old house, feel nostalgic, 'like grandma's house'.

古民家を改装した店内では折敷や抹茶碗など和の器を用い、大和高原の自然栽培抹茶や奈.en: In the renovated old house, Japanese tableware such as oshiki trays and matcha bowls is used, along with naturally grown matcha from the Yamato highlands and certified-organic Nara tea (TE=CHA).

善光寺の西側、湯福神社に隣接する昭和30年代築（築60〜70年ほど）の古民家を改.en: A hideaway café in a renovated old house built in the 1950s–60s (60–70 years old), next to Yubuku Shrine on the west side of Zenkoji, in Yokosawa-machi, Nagano City. You take off your shoes and change into slippers to go in.

善光寺下駅周辺・門前町.en: around Zenkoji-shita Station · the temple town

善光寺公式・hotpepper・rurubu・善光寺御朱印まとめが、約1400年.en: Zenkoji's official site, Hot Pepper, Rurubu and a Zenkoji goshuin round-up back up: a permanent temple lodging of about 1,400 years; the principal image Dainichi Nyorai; renovation in the Heisei era; 39 lodgings; no meat, fish or five pungent vegetables; the head priest's pesticide-free vegetables; the grain-based 'Nagano grain set meal'; house-made sesame tofu; and a finish of Japanese sweets with matcha.

善光寺参拝後に身体を温め、心を整えるための食を提供。お朝事の終了時刻に合わせて開.en: Food to warm the body and settle the mind after visiting Zenkoji. It opens to match the end of the morning service, aiming to give a taste of shojin as the close of the visit.

四季に寄り添うわらび餅——春は花見菓子、夏は冷製、秋は茶菓子、冬は温かく。 国産.en: Warabi mochi that follows the seasons: festive sweets in spring, chilled in summer, tea sweets in autumn, warm in winter. Particular about domestic real bracken starch, aiming for its own springiness and a mellow, melting texture.

変わらない味を守ること。 昭和の雰囲気を残したまま、素朴で飾らない大衆中華を提供.en: Keeping an unchanging flavour. Continuing to serve simple, unpretentious Chinese food in a Showa-era atmosphere.

外見、瀕死じゃないですか.en: Doesn't it look half-dead from the outside?

大きくてコリコリした食感に貝の旨味が出ていてそこにお出汁。」／「厚揚げ。大きくて.en: big and crunchy, the shellfish flavour comes through, plus the dashi." / "Thick fried tofu. Big, it soaks up the broth well, delicious!"

大名つづら（10種以上の季節料理＋抹茶フォンデュのセット御膳）および抹茶フォンデ.en: Daimyo Tsuzura (a set meal of 10+ seasonal dishes plus matcha fondue) and matcha fondue

大和の朝は茶がゆで明ける.en: In Yamato, the morning begins with tea porridge

大和茶ミルク金時.en: Yamato tea milk with sweet beans

大和茶練乳あんぱん.en: Yamato tea and condensed-milk bean bun

大善公式サイトはつなぎなしの十割そば、信濃町黒姫山の霧下そば使用、テレビ東京『い.en: The Daizen official site says it serves 100% buckwheat soba with no binder, uses kirishita (mist-grown) buckwheat from Mt. Kurohime in Shinano-machi, and was featured on TV Tokyo's 'Ii Tabi Yume Kibun' (4 October 2006). food.onarimon says its kaeshi is made by its own method with naturally brewed tamari soy sauce containing no wheat, and aged three months in earthenware jars. The samcamp blog says 'it seems to be run by a young owner', praises 'the new-power spirit of Shinshu soba', and commends the 100% buckwheat technique.

大将自らが毎日仕入れをし、目利きした良いものを提供するというポリシー.en: a policy of the master buying personally every day and serving only what passes a sharp eye

大手回転寿司チェーンでタッチパネル注文が中心のため英語メニューや操作で言葉に頼ら.en: A major conveyor-belt sushi chain with touch-panel ordering, so you can order without relying on English menus or speech; but allergy questions need a word with the staff, and some Japanese helps.

大正時代の佇まいを残す.en: keeping the look of the Taishō era

大町市大町・文化会館サン・アルプス大町棟内.en: Omachi, Omachi City · inside the Sun Alps Omachi Cultural Hall

天ぷら・揚げ物を含む懐石コースで専用フライヤーの有無は不明。グルテン交差汚染リス.en: Kaiseki courses include tempura and fried dishes; whether there is a dedicated fryer is unknown. Nothing has been published about gluten cross-contamination risk.

天ぷら・油物メニューあり（「塩のみで」との記述はあるが専用フライヤーの使用有無は.en: There are tempura and fried items (one note says "with salt only", but whether a dedicated fryer is used is unconfirmed). It may share a kitchen and fryer with wheat-containing fried foods.

失敗を恐れないチャレンジ精神.en: a spirit of challenge that does not fear failure

奄美大島産素焚糖.en: sudaki raw cane sugar from Amami Ōshima

奈良の地に超新星が誕生.en: a supernova is born in Nara

奈良の恵ごはん.en: Nara no Megumi gohan (Nara's bounty set)

奈良ひとまち大学(nhmu.jp)と奈良グルメ図鑑によれば、初代店主は福岡県田川.en: According to Nara Hitomachi University (nhmu.jp) and the Nara Gourmet Guide, the first owner came from Tagawa City, Fukuoka, ran a bicycle shop, then worked as a bartender and coffee wholesaler in Osaka, married a woman from Tenri, and opened in 1966. The curry is onions and beef shoulder simmered 5–6 hours with no secret ingredient. It closed in July 2021 because the building had aged, and reopened in spring 2022 in a small new building on the same spot. The second generation is the founder's daughter, 岡部綾子.

奈良グルメ図鑑とsmall-lifeによれば、コムゴンは東向商店街の2階（1階は.en: According to the Nara Gourmet Guide and small-life, Com Ngon is a Vietnamese restaurant upstairs on the Higashimuki shopping street (Sara Soba Bunraku on the ground floor); the name means 'delicious rice'. Adjusted to Japanese tastes rather than strictly authentic: Hanoi-style phở gà / phở bò, Huế-style bún bò, bún chả, bánh canh, fresh and fried spring rolls and more. Some dishes aren't spicy.

奈良グルメ図鑑・店舗STORES・公式で、大正2年（1913）創業で元々は餅屋、.en: The Nara Gourmet Guide, the shop's STORES page and the official site confirm: founded in Taishō 2 (1913), originally a mochi shop; the tea house 'Rokubōan' in a Naramachi townhouse; the famous 'Naramachi dango' (Yamato tea, miso and azuki on uirō) and 'Kōshin-san', modelled on the migawari-zaru charm; warabi mochi and shaved ice.

奈良地酒めぐり.en: a tour of Nara local sake

奈良市紀寺町565-1、2025年11月7日オープン。国産米粉100%・無添加・.en: 565-1 Kidera-cho, Nara City; opened 7 November 2025. A specialist in chewy bagels of 100% Japanese rice flour, additive-free and gluten-free. The owner is a former firefighter and paramedic who discovered rice-flour bread in October 2024 and started from scratch. Parking for one car behind the shop. Rice-flour bread classes too.

奈良新聞の記事で、1971年創業、村上義廣・三和子夫妻が54年営み、2025年9.en: A Nara Shimbun article confirms: founded in 1971; the couple 村上義廣 and 三和子 ran it for 54 years; in September 2025 the couple's eldest son 力 became the second generation; menma and wakame brought back after 30 years; and the chashu returned to the founding method, simmered over 5 hours with Kōchi ginger, chicken carcasses and chicken feet.

奈良時代、遣唐使によって日本に伝えられた豆腐文化.en: tofu culture, brought to Japan by envoys to Tang China in the Nara period

妥協しない技で寿司に向き合い、心を込めておもてなし致します.en: We face the sushi with uncompromising skill and welcome you with all our heart

妥協のない仕込みと旬の食材が織り成すおもてなし.en: hospitality woven from uncompromising preparation and seasonal ingredients

姫路の名物・穴子（アナゴ）を使った穴子丼。天ぷらや揚げ物、丼ものも提供する。.en: Conger-eel bowls using anago, a Himeji specialty. Also tempura, fried dishes and rice bowls.

姫路の地酒と姫路おでん本舗.en: Himeji no Jizake to Himeji Oden Honpo

姫路まちづくり振興機構の公式ページと好古園資料で、好古園は1992年開園・総面積.en: The Himeji City Urban Development Promotion Organization's official page and Koko-en materials confirm: Koko-en opened in 1992, covers 3.5 ha and was laid out on the site of the west residences; Kassui-ken is the garden's restaurant, serving conger eel dishes, the Hime set meal and more.

姫路みたい特集・神戸新聞(Yahoo!転載)・BASE通販より。NPO法人姫路こ.en: From a Himeji Mitai feature, the Kobe Shimbun (via Yahoo!) and BASE online shop. A Type-B continuing-employment support farm (Yamada-cho Makino 619-1) run by the NPO Himeji Kokoro social-welfare organization. Sells gluten-free "Poritto" snacks made from naturally grown rice flour (bronze at the 2022 Habatake contest) and dried rice-flour noodles directly and online. Holds a Hatake Café once a month.

姫路れんこん饅頭かにあんかけ.en: Himeji lotus-root dumpling with thick crab sauce

姫路地区手をつなぐ育成会.en: Himeji District 'Hand in Hand' support association

姫路城〜姫路駅 · ベジ・グルテンフリー.en: Himeji Castle to Himeji Station · vegetarian and gluten-free

姫路城下町という歴史的な街並みの中に、ブラックを基調とした都会的な外観とオレンジ.en: In the historic castle-town streets, the urban black exterior and orange neon tubes stand out, and passers-by drawn in by the sweet smell of baking have become a familiar sight.

姫路市亀井町、瀬戸内海の恵みを活かした海鮮料理店.en: Kameimachi, Himeji: a seafood restaurant making the most of the Seto Inland Sea

姫路市十二所前町、播磨灘産穴子を専門とする.en: Juniisho-mae-cho, Himeji; specialises in Harima-nada conger eel

姫路市本町68 家老屋敷B棟.en: Honmachi 68, Himeji; chief-retainer residence building B

姫路市本町（姫路城前）.en: Honmachi, Himeji (in front of Himeji Castle)

姫路店の「朝フレンチマン」（平日午前・10:00〜、¥770）はホットサンド＋サ.en: The Himeji shop's "Morning Frenchman" (weekday mornings from 10:00, ¥770) comes with a hot sandwich, salad and a drink. It drew attention as a morning menu unique to the Himeji shop, timed to the building's opening hours.

姫路経済新聞(3周年記事)・TANOSU取材・公式サイトより。店主貝塚暁子さんが.en: From the Himeji Keizai Shimbun (3rd-anniversary article), a TANOSU feature and the official site. The owner, 貝塚暁子, opened in 2019 (3rd anniversary on 8 August 2022). "Organic junkie" with homemade koji seasonings and organic ingredients. Wheat flour and sugar avoided as far as possible; sweets use barley flour and are gluten-free; the pound cake is 100% Kyushu barley flour.

姫路経済新聞・Kiss PRESS・Food Diversity・公式サイトより.en: From the Himeji Keizai Shimbun, Kiss PRESS, Food Diversity and the official site. A former izakaya owner opened on 21 March 2023 in Shirakuni-kitashinmachi. A fully vegan restaurant supervised by Tokyo's Saido. The signature "sai-men" are colourful noodles made from vegetables. Sweets are made by Ibuki of Okayama, free of animal ingredients and the 8 major allergens. The name comes from 菜 (vegetables), sai-men, Saido and sai (rhinoceros) (official).

姫路経済新聞・budou-chan: オーナー見満みなみは2012年に製菓学校卒.en: Himeji Keizai Shimbun and budou-chan: the owner, 見満みなみ, graduated from confectionery school in 2012, studied pastry and cooking in Germany and France for about 8 years, and on 1 October 2025 opened "Miinas", a gluten-free organic café, at Shikisai 638-1, Himeji (right by JR Yobe Station, Aoyama-kita Bldg). About 31 tsubo, 6 tables, 16 seats; everything available to take away. Serves bagels and burgers of 100% domestic organic rice flour. A pet-grooming salon (深山梨江) is attached, separated by a wall.

姫路経済新聞・tanosuで、2025年11月28日開業、店長 菅原早穂子、自家.en: The Himeji Keizai Shimbun and tanosu confirm: opened 28 November 2025; the manager; house-roasted, house-ground almond butter (Classic/Crunch); almond-milk soup; butter chicken curry with 18 spices, almond butter and almond dukkah.

姫路経済新聞：料理長・大庭拓哉（和食歴30年）、店長・松岡加奈子、2025年11.en: Himeji Keizai Shimbun: head chef 大庭拓哉 (30 years in Japanese cuisine); manager 松岡加奈子; opened 27 November 2025; in the Gran Festa basement; fish from the ports of Murotsu, Boze and Shikama; whole sea bream tempura, Himeji oden, live conger eel. KissPress: the name comes from the owner's surname, written in hiragana. Himeji Festa official site: Gran Festa 5-ban-gai, opened 27 November.

姫路駅直結の地下街グランフェスタ内にあり、雨の日でも濡れずにアクセスできる利便性.en: Inside Gran Festa, the underground mall connected to Himeji Station, so you can get there without getting wet on rainy days; popular with business people and travellers for the convenience.

季節に移ろい暦があるように.en: just as the seasons turn and the calendar moves on

季節のプリンは卵・乳を含む可能性。ぽりっと・米粉麺は植物性。.en: The seasonal pudding may contain egg and dairy. Poritto and the rice-flour noodles are plant-based.

季節の和菓子と選りすぐりの日本茶、抹茶。喫茶では季節の和菓子と薄茶のセットのほか.en: Seasonal Japanese sweets with selected Japanese teas and matcha. Besides sets of a seasonal sweet and thin tea, there's a 'whisk-your-own' matcha experience and a full tea seating (seasonal sweet, thick tea, dry sweets, thin tea), plus white shaved ice in summer. Takeaway thick-tea lattes too.

季節折々のおいしさを、くつろぎながら.en: each season's flavours, enjoyed at your ease

宇治金時ミルク.en: Uji matcha, sweet beans and milk

安くてうまい、気軽に立ち寄れる街の中華立ち飲み屋として地元に根付いてきた。.en: Rooted locally as a cheap, tasty neighbourhood Chinese stand-up bar you can drop into easily.

安曇野のジャズファンブログが、店主自作管理のJBLランサーからジャズが流れ、オー.en: An Azumino jazz fan's blog backs up an owner who plays jazz through JBL Lancer speakers the owner built and maintains, and who talks about audio and the history of Zenkoji. ekiten and Retty back up hand-made soba (Nagano buckwheat) along Nakamise and entrances on two sides.

安曇野市に本拠を置く信州の郷土食専門店。 長野・善光寺の仲見世通り（参道）に漬物.en: A Shinshu local-food specialist based in Azumino City. It has a tenant shop on Zenkoji's Nakamise-dori (the temple approach) inside the long-established pickle shop Takahashi Shoten. The main shop is in Swan Garden Azumino, famous for letting you grill the oyaki you buy at an irori hearth where a charcoal fire burns all year.

完全ヴィーガン。動物性原材料・乳製品・精製糖・うまみ調味料・アルコール調味料は不.en: Fully vegan. No animal ingredients, dairy, refined sugar, MSG or alcohol seasonings.

完全予約制で少人数制のため、事前に食の制限を伝える余地がある。オーナーが素材を個.en: Reservation-only with small numbers, so there is room to explain dietary restrictions in advance. A small independent shop where the owner picks ingredients individually, so it may be flexible.

完全予約制の懐石料理店。英語メニューあり（訪日外国人向け対応）。靴を脱いで入店す.en: A reservation-only kaiseki restaurant. English menu available (for overseas visitors). Tatami rooms where you take your shoes off. Cards accepted and set up for overseas guests, but communication is mainly in Japanese.

官公式サイト(mu-sea.com)と伊勢志摩観光ナビ、食べログで確認：2013.en: Confirmed on the official site (mu-sea.com), the Ise-Shima tourism navigator and Tabelog: founded December 2013; the Toba Station branch opened on 7 March 2021; house-roasted coffee and spice-curry bread; a seaside roastery.

家族経営（創業者一族が各店舗を分担）.en: Family business (the founding family shares the running of the branches)

家老屋敷跡.en: site of a chief retainer's residence

寺粥御膳は根菜の煮物や豆腐など植物性食材を中心とした構成と複数のレビューが報告し.en: Several reviews report that the temple porridge set is built mostly from plant ingredients such as simmered root vegetables and tofu.

寺粥御膳（¥1,500）—精進のお粥に根菜や豆腐料理などが添えられるセット。小布.en: The temple rice-porridge set (¥1,500): shojin porridge with root vegetables, tofu dishes and more. Obuse-chestnut kuri-tsuzuri (Mont Blanc), seasonal Japanese sweets and oshiruko are also popular.

寺院：善光寺大勧進（天台宗本坊）.en: Temple: Zenkoji Daikanjin (the Tendai head lodging)

小さなカウンター中心の小料理屋。英語メニューや英語対応スタッフの情報なし。日本語.en: A small counter-centred koryori restaurant. No information on an English menu or English-speaking staff. Communication is basically in Japanese.

小さな地元向け割烹居酒屋で、英語メニューや外国語対応の記載は一切なく、日本語のみ.en: A small local kappo izakaya with no mention of an English menu or other languages; Japanese only.

小さな町のなかのレストラン.en: a restaurant in a small town

小チャーシュー煮玉子ラーメン.en: ramen with small chashu and simmered egg

小僧またおまえか。土佐堀店.en: Kozou Mata Omae Ka, Tosabori branch

小川真宏氏は約30年にわたり淵之坊の厨房を取り仕切り、善光寺の祭礼食をベースにし.en: 小川真宏 (Ogawa Masahiro) has run the Fuchinobo kitchen for about 30 years, creating seasonal menus based on Zenkoji's festival food.

小町記事(261229)で文政10年(1827)創業・八代目藤澤浩一が銀行員を経.en: A Komachi article (261229) confirms: founded in Bunsei 10 (1827); eighth-generation 藤澤浩一 took over in 1999 after working as a banker; trained under 片倉康雄 of Isshoan; kirishita buckwheat grown by 石川浩幸 in Shinano-machi; a 91% blend. The official site (fujikian.co.jp/en) states it was founded in 1827, in the time of the 11th shogun Tokugawa Ienari, is a soba shop of eight generations, and uses Kurohime kirishita buckwheat (no mention of katsudon). Saijiki confirms three dipping sauces (dashi, walnut, grated yam).

小規模な古民家カフェで英語メニューや英語対応の記録はなく、日本語のみの環境と思わ.en: A small old-house café with no record of an English menu or English service; probably a Japanese-only setting.

小規模な就労施設の製造・直売所。米粉製品専用ラインか小麦と共用かは未確認。要確認.en: A small welfare-workplace production site and farm shop. Whether there is a dedicated rice-flour line or it is shared with wheat is unconfirmed. To be confirmed.

小豆餡、小麦粉、砂糖、大豆油、そば粉、酵母、食塩.en: red-bean paste, wheat flour, sugar, soybean oil, buckwheat flour, yeast, salt

小麦の可能性。要確認。.en: May contain wheat. To be confirmed.

小麦を一切扱わない完全グルテンフリー＆ヴィーガンの菓子工房で、全商品が対象。添加.en: A fully gluten-free and vegan sweets workshop that handles no wheat at all, covering every product. Additives too are 'avoided as far as we can'.

小麦アレルギーの方でも安心.en: safe even for people with a wheat allergy

小麦アレルギーの方も安心して食べられるそう」.en: apparently people with a wheat allergy can eat with peace of mind"

小麦・そば・卵・乳・落花生・えび・かに・くるみ.en: wheat, buckwheat, egg, milk, peanut, shrimp, crab, walnut

小麦・乳・卵不使用、有機豆乳使用.en: no wheat, milk or egg; organic soy milk

小麦・卵・乳製品・白砂糖は不使用.en: no wheat, egg, dairy or white sugar

小麦・大麦の有無を要確認。.en: Check whether it contains wheat or barley.

小麦粉は一部メニューのみ使用.en: wheat flour used in some dishes only

小麦粉は一部メニューのみ使用、トーストも提供＝共用調理環境。要相談。.en: Wheat flour is used in some dishes only, and toast is served too: a shared cooking environment. Ask.

小麦粉は完全不使用で、米粉やアーモンドの粉などを使用。工房全体がグルテンフリー専.en: No wheat flour at all; rice flour, almond flour and the like are used. The whole workshop is dedicated gluten-free, so the risk of wheat getting in is structurally very low.

小麦粉や乳製品不使用で、安心の無添加（玄米粉シフォン）／ 小麦粉も乳製品も卵も不.en: Reassuringly additive-free with no wheat flour or dairy (brown-rice-flour chiffon) / vegan treats with no wheat flour, dairy or egg (white-rice-flour muffins) / a gluten-free snack specialist using rice flour from the prefecture…

小麦粉ルウ・醤油不使用か確認.en: check: no flour roux or soy sauce?

小麦粉不使用で調理。ただしソース/調味料の醤油・味噌の小麦要確認。.en: Cooked without wheat flour. But check the soy sauce and miso in the sauces and seasonings for wheat.

居酒屋の居抜き.en: in a former izakaya's fitted premises

山の幸・川の幸.en: the bounty of the mountains and rivers

工房には卵・乳製品・小麦を持ち込まない.en: no egg, dairy or wheat is brought into the workshop

工房全体が完全ヴィーガンで卵・乳製品を一切扱わないため、動物性食材との交差接触リ.en: The whole workshop is fully vegan and handles no egg or dairy at all, so there is no risk of cross-contact with animal ingredients.

平宗は文久元年（1861）、吉野・上市村で平井宗八が創業。明治35年に料理旅館化.en: Hiraso was founded in Bunkyū 1 (1861) in Kamiichi village, Yoshino, by Hirai Sōhachi. In Meiji 35 it became a culinary inn, and in 1962 (Shōwa 37) it introduced persimmon-leaf sushi widely at the Tennoji Station building. In 1951 (Shōwa 26) it presented ayu sushi to Emperor Shōwa. The Nara shop opened in 1968 (Shōwa 43) in Naramachi, by Sarusawa Pond, within earshot of Kōfukuji's bell, and also offers a hands-on persimmon-leaf sushi-making experience by reservation.

年5月に「小麦アレルギー」と判明し、体調回復を機に国産山田錦米粉100.en: in May (2019) a 'wheat allergy' was diagnosed, and with recovery came a switch to 100% Japanese Yamada Nishiki rice flour

年中無休.en: open every day of the year

床の間に季節の花や軸をしつらえ、庭を望む町家の座敷で、スタッフの手ほどきを受けな.en: In a townhouse tatami room facing the garden, with seasonal flowers and a scroll in the tokonoma, guests can try 'whisk-your-own' matcha with guidance from the staff.

店が『グルテンフリー』と明示。特別栽培米の米粉＋有機米油。卵使用の可能性あり要確.en: The shop states "gluten-free". Specially cultivated rice flour plus organic rice oil. May contain egg; to be confirmed.

店主の武田香織さんは関東（神奈川県）出身。会社員をしながら調理師免許を取得し、大.en: Owner 武田香織 is from Kanagawa in the Kanto region. While working at a company, the owner qualified as a cook and trained for about two years at a French restaurant in Osaka. Moved by Miwa sōmen from Sakurai, the owner decided to move to Nara and in April 2019 opened a sōmen specialist in a renovated Naramachi townhouse. The signature is sea-bream-broth sōmen using the French technique fumet de poisson, with unusual variations such as tomato sōmen of wholemeal noodles.

店主はカフェ商品開発時に食物アレルギーを研究し、3大アレルゲン不使用スイーツの製.en: The owner researched food allergies while developing café products, and the business began with making and selling sweets free of the three major allergens. Allergy handling is at the core of the business.

店主は元スペイン料理店『Gentry』のオーナーシェフで、2021年3月に同店を.en: The owner is the former owner-chef of the Spanish restaurant 'Gentry', which closed in March 2021; Bocarroz opened in April the same year.

店主は全国のわらび餅を食べ歩き、ミシュランシェフとタイアップして「ぜいみ」を完成.en: The official site says the owner ate warabi mochi all over Japan and completed "Zeimi" in a tie-up with a Michelin-starred chef.

店主は大阪の有名店ラーメン人生.en: the owner is from the famous Osaka shop Ramen Jinsei

店全体が100%プラントベースで動物性食材を扱わないため、ヴィーガンの交差接触リ.en: The whole shop is 100% plant-based and handles no animal ingredients, so the vegan cross-contact risk is low.

店全体が小麦粉を一切使わない100%グルテンフリー方針のため、店内に小麦を持ち込.en: The whole shop follows a 100% gluten-free policy with no wheat flour at all, so no wheat is brought into the kitchen. No dedicated fryer or strict celiac protocol is stated, so with severe celiac disease it's safest to check when you visit.

近江町市場公式(ohmicho-ichiba)・食べログ: 金沢発祥の回転寿司で.en: Omicho Market official site and Tabelog: conveyor-belt sushi born in Kanazawa, with several shops in the city. The Omicho shop is on the first floor of Omicho Ichiba-kan. Serves Hokuriku local fish (blackthroat seaperch, white shrimp and more). Famous for the 'Morimori three-piece platter' of jumbo botan shrimp, sea urchin and fatty tuna, and the daily 'Omicho three-piece platter'. Queues for numbered tickets before opening.

近江町市場公式・週末金沢で、老舗寿司店出身の店主が目利き、12種盛りの魚旨丼(2.en: The Omicho Market official site and Shūmatsu Kanazawa confirm: an owner from a long-established sushi shop who picks the fish; the Uouma bowl of 12 toppings (¥2,480); local ingredients such as Oku-Noto Koshihikari, Hakusan underground water, pure rice vinegar from Tsurugi and a sushi soy sauce based on Ono soy sauce; house-made omelette; tourists and local regulars.

近江町市場内、カウンター約10席の小さな海鮮丼店。朝7時開店、金沢港直送の鮮魚。.en: A small seafood-bowl shop of about 10 counter seats inside Omicho Market. Opens at 7 am; fresh fish straight from Kanazawa Port. Premium Hokuriku bowl about ¥2,500, mini Kanazawa bowl about ¥1,200, nigiri priced by the plate. You write your name and phone number on paper on the glass door and are called. The Ikiikitei bowl serves the toppings and rice in separate containers.

近鉄奈良駅前.en: in front of Kintetsu Nara Station

近鉄鳥羽駅から徒歩約4分。店内に海女小屋を再現した「海女小屋席」があり、活伊勢海.en: About 4 minutes' walk from Kintetsu Toba Station. The restaurant has 'ama hut seats' recreating an ama diver's hut, and charcoal hearth-grilled live Ise lobster and live abalone are the speciality (the charcoal course is currently suspended). The most popular dish is the 'tekone-zushi set', a local dish of the Shima area (soy-marinated bonito on vinegared rice); the generous seafood bowl, Ise lobster and abalone sashimi set, and big fried shrimp are also well reviewed. There's a fish tank at the entrance, stump-style tables and tatami seating; in winter grilled turban shell gives way to grilled oysters.

通の食べ方.en: the connoisseur's way to eat it

通信販売を続ける中で「工房でも販売してほしい」という声に応えて長野市三輪に実店舗.en: While selling by mail order, in response to requests to 'sell at the workshop too', a shop opened in Miwa, Nagano City, then moved on 15 January 2022 to a shop with a café in front of Nagano Station.

週末金沢・tacsp・かなざわ速報で、2022年3月1日開業、元たんば屋跡、北海.en: Shūmatsu Kanazawa, tacsp and Kanazawa Sokuho confirm: opened 1 March 2022 on the former Tanbaya site; buckwheat flour from Uryū (Isoya), Hokkaido; duck dipping soba with Zaō duck broth (¥1,800); run single-handedly by a female owner; the wish that guests 'enjoy it to the end without tiring'.

Reviews (December 2025 – June 2026): careful Japanese cooking; overseas diners too; a lavish course of about ¥10,000; matsuba crab; ankimo monaka; bonito tataki with myoga; eel omelette; a rare Japanese izakaya open from lunchtime; A5 Kuroge wagyu rib-roast sukiyaki hitsumabushi gozen ¥3,800; courses only at night; a friendly owner; dashi served in a flask; kakigori with house syrup; kind staff; seafood, meat, hot pot and rice to suit your appetite; requests accommodated; a calm Japanese interior; for business entertaining and special days too.

Reviews (April–October 2026): summer-only tsukesoba; tori soba salt; tori soba shoyu ¥1,000; ticket machine; a chicken soup with strong shoyu; thin wavy noodles; pork and chicken-breast chashu; fried burdock; a deep bowl; spicy tori soba ¥1,100; a refined atmosphere; limited Jiro style; cold jidori soba with rice; flat noodles; 6 waiting at 19:30 on a Sunday; a rich, smooth, potage-like chicken soup; 2 kinds of chashu, moist chicken and chewy pork.

Reviews (December 2024 – March 2026): Kinki shabu-shabu course; private rooms; fatty Kinki; high-grade fish from Hokkaido; moved after the old building was demolished; zosui to finish; at the back of the ground floor of a nightclub building; a Japanese interior suited to business entertaining; sashimi; simmered, grilled and fried dishes; seasonal ingredients; a sake selection; New Year party; a tag attached to the Kinki.

金沢1号店は現地の人気店「麺屋大河」が手掛けてオープンし、長野店は長野拠点の「吟.en: The first Kanazawa shop was opened by the popular local shop Menya Taiga; the Nagano branch is run by the Nagano-based Ginya group (owner Kawamoto Tenshi) under the supervision of Watanabe Yasuyuki, owner of Tokyo's Chuka Soba Kibi. PR TIMES confirms new products using koji fermentation from 2025.

Within a garden of about 1,000 tsubo stand a main building from the Meiji era and sukiya-style annexes. It has built its history as a leading culinary inn of the castle town of Kanazawa.

The Himeji Ekimae shop opened on Wednesday 13 May 2026 at Ekimae-cho 294 B1F. The aim is to spread honetsuki-dori, a local dish from Marugame, Kagawa, to other regions.

門藤は2021年6月22日、姫路城の麓の本町商店街にオープンした本わらび餅の専門.en: Kadofuji is a specialist in real bracken-starch warabi mochi, opened on 22 June 2021 in the Honmachi shopping street at the foot of Himeji Castle. The founder ate warabi mochi all over Japan and, after much trial and error, developed an original recipe using domestic real bracken-starch flour. The signature "Warabi Mochi Zeimi", created in a tie-up with a Michelin-starred chef, is known for its jiggly, melting texture and rich kinako flavour. It has since expanded through franchising to 12 shops nationwide.

開店15分前から並んでも2巡目待ちになることがある人気ぶり。著者はとん汁目当てに.en: So popular that even lining up 15 minutes before opening can mean waiting for the second sitting. The writer came for the tonjiru and called it "addictive, with the sweetness of nearly melting onions and rich miso".

開店以来ランチタイムは満席になるほどの人気。8年経った2025年現在も昼時は落ち.en: Since opening, lunchtime has been popular enough to fill every seat. In 2025, eight years on, it still fills up at midday in a calm atmosphere.

開店間もない2026年5月の来店者レビューでは「皮はパリッと香ばしく、かぶりつく.en: A visitor's review from May 2026, just after opening, was favourable: "the skin is crisp and fragrant, and when you bite in, juices and chicken flavour flood out".

開業時からの人気デザート「自家製わらび餅」は食事に付き、多くのリピーターに愛され.en: The homemade warabi mochi, a popular dessert since opening, comes with meals and has many repeat fans.
