食べログ (店舗会員の公式情報): Stand カテナッチョ (旧店名 肉寿司.en: Tabelog (shop member's official info): Stand Catenaccio (formerly Niku Sushi Italian Bar Kannuki Shinsaibashi), B1F, 1-19-11 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 2 min walk from Shinsaibashi Station; daily 18:00–3:00 next morning (L.O. 2:30); opened 12 July 2017; reopened after renovation as a standing bar; counter 8 and two tables for 4; private room for 5 or more; cards and QR accepted, no e-money; smoking allowed. Reviews (February–September 2026): renovated into a standing bar in September 2026; same cooks and staff as before; Japanese and Italian combined; starter platter (molokhia ohitashi, bagna càuda, chilled tofu with caviar, raisin-butter yatsuhashi); zucchini fritters in beer batter with bamboo-charcoal salt; lobster cream spring rolls with Grana Padano; duck carpaccio with balsamic; crab pasta; water aubergine; soup or ochazuke to finish; caramel pudding; meat sushi before the renovation (one says it's gone since); a small but good sake list.

食べログ (店舗会員の公式情報): YAKINIKUEN 忍鬨 東心斎橋2号店、.en: Tabelog (shop member's official info): YAKINIKUEN Ning Higashi-Shinsaibashi No. 2, APA Hotel Namba Shinsaibashi Higashi 1F, 1-7-10 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; about 4 min walk from Nagahoribashi Station; Mon–Wed, Fri–Sun and holidays 15:00–24:00, Thu 17:00–24:00 (food L.O. 23:00); irregular closing days; opened 12 April 2022; 90-minute limit; automatic cancellation at 10 minutes late; starter ¥300; cards, e-money and PayPay accepted; no smoking; 20 seats (counter 12, 2 tables); children welcome; thick-cut leek-wrapped tongue; selected misuji exclusive to the No. 2 shop. Reviews (June–October 2026): a calm black-toned interior; smokeless roasters; the leek-wrapped tongue is wrapped in leek with garlic and ginger; Ning set ¥9,680 (11 cuts, 60 g each); tongue yukhoe ¥1,408; gimbap topped with yukhoe ¥1,408; yukhoe sushi; kimchi platter; gelato after the meal; one says one side of the grill didn't cook and the beer was frozen.

食べログ (店舗会員の公式情報): mahoroba 鉄板 心斎橋、大阪市中央区.en: Tabelog (shop member's official info): mahoroba Teppan Shinsaibashi, 1-7-23 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Shinsaibashi and Nagahoribashi stations; daily 12:00–14:00 (L.O. 13:30) and 17:00–23:00 (L.O. 22:30); opened 6 April 2023; service charge; cards and PayPay accepted, no e-money; heated tobacco only; 16 seats (counter 6, 2 private rooms); children welcome (pushchairs to private rooms); sommelier; Kuroge wagyu; seasonal vegetables and seafood. Reviews (August–October 2026): more relaxed than expected; the chef explains ingredients and jokes; flames in front of you; steak with a choice of doneness and cut; with wasabi; ise-ebi, abalone and wagyu course about ¥24,000; lunch about ¥3,000–4,000; à la carte if there's room; a surprise anniversary cake.

食べログ (店舗会員の公式情報): しゃぶ長、大阪市中央区東心斎橋1-15-25.en: Tabelog (shop member's official info): Shabu Cho, 1-15-25 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Shinsaibashi Station; Mon–Fri 11:30–13:30 and 17:30–23:00 (L.O. 22:00), Sat 17:30–23:00, holidays 17:30–22:00; closed Sundays; opened 1 November 1978; 16 counter seats; may direct you to another branch when full; cards, e-money and QR accepted; no smoking; children welcome (no children's chairs); English, Chinese and Korean menus; shabu-shabu and sukiyaki of A5 wagyu and premium pork; house ponzu and sesame sauce; the famous frozen sake. Reviews (April–September 2026): always a queue at lunch; hot pot for one; lunch sukiyaki from ¥1,400; 1.5× meat ¥2,000; large ¥2,400; a pot with udon, shirataki, bean sprouts, leek and onion, and thin-sliced meat on a separate plate; comes with rice, pickles, egg and oolong tea; free refills of rice and tea; the annex Shabu Cho Hanare (18 seats at an L-shaped counter, IH); one says cash only at lunch; one recommends the leaner cuts.

食べログ (店舗会員の公式情報): カンジャンケジャン 渡 大阪心斎橋店、大阪市.en: Tabelog (shop member's official info): Kanjang Kejang Watari Osaka Shinsaibashi, ENT Nagahori Bldg 5F, 1-3-7 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; right by Nagahoribashi Station exit 6; daily 17:00–23:00; open every day of the year; opened 15 June 2025; all private and semi-private rooms; cards, e-money and QR accepted; heated tobacco only; 18 seats; 'luxury in the everyday'; raw blue swimming crab in shoyu, prepared Japanese-style; rare sakes. Reviews (September–October 2026): ¥6,980 course; ganjang gejang with rice, soup and namul; shoyu-marinated shrimp with lemon; japchae; jeon; nakopsae of octopus, shrimp, crab, scallop and offal; to finish, noodles with egg yolk, cheese and black pepper, or congee; shiso sorbet or ice cream; private rooms with sunken kotatsu; staff check how you're feeling before the raw crab; one found portions smaller than expected; one says an unannounced 2-hour limit meant being hurried out.

食べログ (店舗会員の公式情報): ワインショップ&ダイナー FUJIMARU.en: Tabelog (shop member's official info): Wine Shop & Diner FUJIMARU Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Uehara Bldg 2F, 1-4-18 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 2 min walk from Nagahoribashi Station exit 7; 2F diner Tue–Sat and holidays 17:00–23:00 (food L.O. 22:00); 1F wine shop 15:00–22:00; 1F standing bar 17:00–22:00; closed Sundays and Mondays; reservations for the 2nd floor only; cards accepted, no e-money or QR; no smoking; 18 seats (counter 6, tables 12); a group of wine shops and restaurants in Tokyo and Osaka; about 1,000 wines on the ground floor; upstairs, the long-established Portuguese restaurant Casa da Andorinha, moved from Hommachi (octopus salad, bacalhau croquettes, Alentejo style); Portuguese wine and Madeira; when full, guests are sent to the sister shop RAINDROP in Tanimachi-Yonchome. Reviews (July–September 2026): ¥5,500 course (starter platter, bacalhau croquettes, salad, Tamba chicken piri-piri, seafood cataplana, risotto to finish, freshly baked egg tart); octopus carpaccio; port wine; Minoh beer; bottles from downstairs for a corkage fee; help choosing wine; one wanted Vinho Verde; booking recommended.

食べログ (店舗会員の公式情報): 不純喫茶 アルテミス、大阪市中央区宗右衛門町.en: Tabelog (shop member's official info): Fujun Kissa Artemis, Minami Bldg 2F, 2-25 Soemoncho, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 375 m from Nippombashi Station; Mon–Fri 19:00–6:00 next morning, Sat, Sun and holidays 13:00–6:00 next morning (L.O. 5:30); open every day of the year; no reservations; cover charge ¥550; cards, e-money and PayPay accepted; smoking allowed; 20 seats (counter 4, sofa seats, 2 private rooms). Reviews (February–July 2026): a Showa-retro night cafe; pudding; Macallan; terrine; banana split; pancakes and iced coffee; Napolitan topped with an omelette; zodiac fortune slips; a waiting board at the entrance on Saturday afternoons; occasional queues; quiet at 4 a.m.; one says staff asked for cash for bills under ¥5,000.

食べログ (店舗会員の公式情報): 九志焼亭 本店、大阪市中央区難波5-1-18.en: Tabelog (shop member's official info): Kushi Yaki Tei main shop, Takashimaya Osaka Namba Dining Maison 8F, 5-1-18 Namba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 1 min walk from Namba Station; daily 11:00–16:00 (L.O. 15:00) and 17:00–22:00 (L.O. 21:00); closing days follow Dining Maison; reservations weekday evenings only; charge ¥300 per person; cards, e-money and QR accepted; no smoking; 20 seats (counter 6, tables 14); children welcome; opened 1 November 2017; official site; skewers of meat, fish and vegetables, seasonal creative dishes, teppanyaki. Reviews (December 2024 – July 2026): skewers grilled on the teppan and served on a plate; pork-wrapped asparagus; wagyu; salmon tartare; meat-wrapped enoki; shrimp paste; tsukune; chicken neck and asparagus; pork belly and leek; monthly limited skewers; omakase 9 skewers at lunch; Osaka-speciality course of 5 skewers, mini okonomiyaki and dashimaki; dashimaki set meal ¥1,800; seasonal 12-skewer course at night; dashimaki with grated daikon; tonpei-yaki heaped with katsuobushi; garlic rice; Amaou strawberry ice cream.

食べログ (店舗会員の公式情報): 和牛ステーキ しばらく、大阪市中央区東心斎橋.en: Tabelog (shop member's official info): Wagyu Steak Shibaraku, 1-4-23 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 2 min walk from Nagahoribashi Station exit 7; daily 11:00–23:00 (food L.O. 22:00); irregular closing days; opened 16 December 2025; cancelled at 15 minutes late; cards and PayPay accepted, no e-money; no smoking; 20 seats (counter); English digital menu; children welcome; lean wagyu steak by chosen origin and cut, with rice chosen to match steak. Reviews (April–July 2026): lean 200 g ¥3,960 (incl. tax); pre-cut into bite-size pieces; tender and juicy; tasting with sirloin cap; freshly grated wasabi; comes with beef-tendon curry, kimchi and miso soup; free rice refills; good rice; many repeat visitors; one found the staff chat a bit much.

食べログ (店舗会員の公式情報): 嗜酒、大阪市中央区東心斎橋1-17-3 GR.en: Tabelog (shop member's official info): SHU SHU, GROOVE Shinsaibashi East 4F, 1-17-3 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3 min walk from Shinsaibashi Station exit 6; Mon–Wed, Sun and holidays 18:00–1:00 next morning (L.O. 23:00), Fri–Sat 18:00–3:30 next morning (L.O. 2:30); closed Thursdays; last-entry times apply; starter ¥550; non-alcoholic drinks for only one person per group; 2-hour limit when busy; cards, e-money and QR accepted; no smoking; 17 seats (counter 9, 2 tables); sakes that change every visit; Kagoshima chicken sashimi; seasonal ingredients; a warm wooden interior. Reviews (January–July 2026): creative small plates; taro manju of beef and burdock in nameko sauce; spring-cabbage and prosciutto croquettes; firefly squid in sweet vinegar; dried firefly squid; firefly-squid clay-pot rice; bluefin tuna and seared mackerel sashimi; fried fig; eel; horse meat; fried house curry bread (takeaway too); kasujiru; tomato chuhai; gin; cute tableware and sake cups; ordering the course when booking is good value.

食べログ (店舗会員の公式情報): 天carat、大阪市中央区東心斎橋1-16-.en: Tabelog (shop member's official info): Ten carat, Nippo Suomachi Arden 1F, 1-16-7 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Shinsaibashi Station; Mon–Sat and holidays 17:00–3:00 next morning (food L.O. 2:00), Sun 17:00–24:00; irregular closing days; opened 30 September 2023; same-day bookings until 90 minutes before closing; seat charge ¥330; cards, e-money and QR accepted; heated tobacco only; 13 counter seats; English, Chinese and Korean menus; English-speaking staff; 6 sakes. Reviews (August–October 2026): ¥4,400 course; toro-taku canapé; soft-boiled egg with shibazuke tartare; Camembert with honey; big prawn; a whole anago; autumn aubergine; Carat Roll ¥1,540 (salmon, sea bream and fish roe rolled with myoga and shiso); nikusui; juwari soba tsuke-soba; sweet-potato tempura with vanilla ice cream; sparkling sake Mio ¥1,210; served freshly fried and piping hot.

食べログ (店舗会員の公式情報): 天ぷら互生 心斎橋、大阪市中央区西心斎橋1-.en: Tabelog (shop member's official info): Tempura Gosei Shinsaibashi, No. 5 Ace Bldg 2F, 1-8-22 Nishi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 1 min walk from Shinsaibashi Station exit 7 and Yotsubashi Station exit 5; daily 18:00–24:00; irregular closing days; reservations only; please avoid strong perfume or hair products; cards and PayPay accepted, no e-money; no smoking; 12 seats (counter 8, one table for 4); sommelier; English menu; official site. Reviews (June–October 2026): run by two people, one a sommelier; an L-shaped counter; starts with cold kuzu somen with sudachi; baby octopus; kamaage shirasu with sansho; mountain vegetables; clay-pot rice with sea urchin; Amakusa sweet-shrimp tempura (crisp heads); shiso wraps; scallop; vegetables; grated daikon; curry to finish too; an affordable wine and sake pairing; light tempura easy on the stomach; tableware by Shiga potters; budget ¥15,000–30,000.

食べログ (店舗会員の公式情報): 心斎橋の美味しい串カツ あげてんかっ！ 本店.en: Tabelog (shop member's official info): Shinsaibashi no Oishii Kushikatsu Agetenka! main shop, Fujieda Bldg 1F, 1-13-1 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3 min walk from Nagahoribashi Station; daily 17:00–2:00 next morning (L.O. 1:00); may direct you to a nearby group shop when full; starter ¥385; cards, e-money and QR accepted; smoking allowed; 13 seats; BYO allowed; English, Chinese and Korean menus; all-you-can-drink; a light, crisp 'saku-karai' batter; domestic wagyu; angel shrimp; house salmon tartare; frozen-lemon sour. Reviews (August–October 2026): fried in front of you; a light batter you could eat endlessly; wagyu; shrimp; kisu; Camembert; pork; onion; pickled ginger; marinated-tuna kushikatsu; oden; the owner's cheerful character; friendly staff; budget ¥4,000–8,000; one says an order didn't go through and the bill was wrong.

食べログ (店舗会員の公式情報): 月虹 (旧店名 鉄板ダイニング KAYA)、.en: Tabelog (shop member's official info): Gekko (formerly Teppan Dining KAYA), Minami Grand Kaikan 1F, 2-5-19 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3 min walk from Shinsaibashi Station; daily 18:00–23:30; occasional irregular closures; opened 27 May 2017; reservations accepted; students may be refused even with a booking; children by arrangement; dress code (no sandals, sweatpants, tracksuits or work clothes); 6 counter seats and 4 table seats; cards accepted, no e-money or QR; heated tobacco only; house sauce and chewy yakisoba; A5 Saga beef fillet course; about 10 red wines. Reviews (June–October 2026): a counter around the teppan; the owner cooks in front of you; the signature Gekko-yaki (a fluffy batter of egg and cabbage with thick-cut pork); kimchi cheese ¥2,700; seafood yakisoba carbonara ¥2,500; seafood salt-grilled ¥2,000–2,400; stir-fried vegetables topped with abura-kasu ¥1,000; curry yakisoba; ikatama; stir-fried vegetables with soba; grilled asparagus; squid, salt bean sprouts and konnyaku; omelette; Kaku highball ¥750; glass of wine ¥1,000; one found it salty overall; budget ¥6,000–8,000.

食べログ (店舗会員の公式情報): 炭火焼き無限バーグ 無限、大阪市中央区難波千.en: Tabelog (shop member's official info): Sumibiyaki Mugen Burg Mugen, 14-3 Namba Sennichimae, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3 min walk from Namba Station; daily 11:30–22:00 (L.O. 21:00); closes when the hamburg runs out; irregular closing days; weekday lunch 11:30–15:00; automatic cancellation at 15 minutes late; no cards or e-money; PayPay accepted; no smoking, but heavy charcoal smoke, so not recommended for high-school age and under; English-speaking staff; 18 seats (counter 10, 2 tables); all-you-can-eat charcoal-grilled hamburg, wanko-style; free refills of egg, salad, rice and condiments; all-you-can-drink. Reviews (September–October 2026): they keep coming until you show the 'I'm satisfied' card; once stopped, it can't be restarted; 30- or 60-minute courses; crisp outside, fluffy and juicy inside; bite-size; salt, wasabi, yuzu-kosho, grated-daikon ponzu, ketchup, chili oil, fiery sauce; egg on rice; one ate 20 in an hour; with two staff, gaps when busy.

食べログ (店舗会員の公式情報): 炭火焼鳥と鶏肴keshiki.、大阪市中央区.en: Tabelog (shop member's official info): Sumibi Yakitori to Toriate keshiki., Mikawa Bldg 1F, 1-14-19 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3 min walk from Shinsaibashi and Nagahoribashi stations; Mon, Tue and Fri–Sun 18:00–5:00 next morning (L.O. 4:00); closed Wednesdays and Thursdays; opened 14 September 2019; 10 counter seats; bookings with Japanese mobile numbers only; some items unavailable depending on supply; cards and PayPay accepted, no e-money; smoking allowed; over 30 yakitori cuts including rare ones from Tamba chicken, Tokushima young chicken and Daisen Jidori; seasonings such as white-wine sauce, escargot butter and black-truffle oil; shochu and sake. Reviews (October 2025 – August 2026): the omakase is good value; vegetable skewers; garlic edamame; egg nyumen to finish; negima; tsukune; charcoal aroma; one found the duck tataki so-so; busy around 19:00, so book; good for a second stop at 1 a.m. too.

食べログ (店舗会員の公式情報): 蕎麦しゃぶ総本家 浪花そば なんばダイニング.en: Tabelog (shop member's official info): Soba Shabu Sohonke Naniwa Soba Namba Dining Maison, Namba Dining Maison 7F, 5-1-18 Namba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 1 min walk from Namba Station; Sun–Thu 11:00–21:30 (L.O. 21:00), Fri–Sat 11:00–22:00 (L.O. 21:30); hot-pot orders close earlier; open every day of the year; opened 2 March 2010; reservations accepted; cards, e-money and QR accepted; no smoking; 18 seats; children welcome (kids' menu of soba and inari); house soba and dashi; the trademarked 'soba shabu'; courses from ¥5,000, with all-you-can-drink from ¥6,500. Reviews (September–October 2026): a chain of 4 shops in Osaka; meat tsuke-soba (chili oil) ¥1,300; thin with soba-yu at the end to drink as soup; cold sudachi soba ¥1,280; large ¥220; tempura set ¥500; ume tororo ¥1,080; fried aubergine and grated-daikon soba ¥1,050; inari ¥800; pressed shrimp sushi; oyakodon set; chicken-nanban soba; a gentle Kansai dashi; colourful chairs.

食べログ (店舗会員の公式情報): 鉄板dining 葉 -you-、大阪市中央.en: Tabelog (shop member's official info): Teppan Dining Yo, Nippo Bamboo Alley Bldg 1F, 1-9-20 Nishi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; opposite J Hotel; 3 min walk from Shinsaibashi Station exit 7; daily 18:00–24:00 (L.O. 23:00); some days closes early; bookings 17:30–23:00; opened 5 December 2022; 18 seats (counter 8, tables 10); cards, e-money and QR accepted; smoking allowed; all-you-can-drink; listed as able to cater for vegans and vegetarians; teppan-grilled Chinese yam; negiyaki; shochu, wine and sake. Reviews (May 2023 – October 2026): a clean shop with a wooden interior; message cards on the tables; sweets on leaving; modan okonomiyaki of pork, oyster or mixed; Hiroshima style; teppan Chinese yam; cheese tonpei-yaki; salt sobameshi; shrimp mayo; shrimp toast; salt offal; gizzard; thick-cut beef tongue; oysters; tomato; English menu; one didn't care for the sauce; one person in the kitchen, so service is a little slow; reasonable prices.

食べログ (店舗会員の公式情報): 鉄板工房 Panyo、大阪市中央区道頓堀2-.en: Tabelog (shop member's official info): Teppan Kobo Panyo, Chiyonoya Bldg 1F, 2-4-10 Dotonbori, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 4 min walk from Namba Station exit 25; daily 11:30–15:00 (L.O. 14:00) and 17:00–22:00 (L.O. 20:30); reservations accepted; discuss allergies and preferences in advance; 12 seats (7 counter seats, 1 semi-private room); private-room fee ¥500 per person at lunch, ¥3,000 per room at dinner; cards and e-money accepted, no QR; budget dinner ¥8,000–9,999, lunch ¥3,000–3,999; wagyu, live shrimp, live abalone, selected wagyu or Matsusaka steak; Panyo Dinner (seared meat sushi, Panyo burger, domestic fillet steak; 9 dishes). Reviews (December 2025 – August 2026): a counter facing the teppan and a private room at the back; the Dotonbori River visible from the private room; seasonal grilled vegetables (turnip, pumpkin, leek); domestic beef fillet 80 g with salt, garlic and wasabi; Panyo-style garlic rice (+¥880, with chicken soup) or curry; meat upgraded to 100 g on the lunch course; fireworks and a message on a celebration dessert; on request, the meat sushi was cooked through properly.

食べログ (店舗会員の公式情報): 鉄板焼 神戸 ホテルモントレ グラスミア大阪.en: Tabelog (shop member's official info): Teppanyaki Kobe, Hotel Monterey Grasmere Osaka 22F, 1-2-3 Minatomachi, Naniwa-ku, Osaka; 1 min walk from JR Namba Station, connected to subway Namba Station; Wed–Mon and holidays 11:30–14:30 (food L.O. 13:30) and 17:30–22:00 (food L.O. 20:00); closed Tuesdays; course prices include tax and service; cannot cater for Rosaceae allergies; cards, e-money and QR accepted; no smoking; two counters of 6; special courses such as Yonezawa beef every two months. Reviews (June–October 2026): big 22nd-floor windows looking out to Kyocera Dome, Kobe, Rokko and the Akashi Kaikyo Bridge; lunch course; A5 beef steak lunch; at night the Maya and Rokko courses; live abalone with liver sauce; ise-ebi; scallop and shrimp; 4 seasonal vegetables; Kuroge wagyu sirloin cap, rib roast and fillet; 2 sauces and 3 salts; garlic rice or black curry (+¥500); red miso soup; dessert; one says lunch prices rose and the 80 g steak felt small; conversation with the chef.

食べログ (店舗会員の公式情報): 鉄板焼き 銀ひかり、大阪市中央区東心斎橋1-.en: Tabelog (shop member's official info): Teppanyaki Gin Hikari, Arashi Hotel 2F, 1-16-5 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Shinsaibashi Station; Mon–Wed and Fri–Sun 12:00–15:00 and 17:00–23:00 (food L.O. 22:30); closed Thursdays; lunch by reservation the day before, currently suspended; 10% service charge at dinner only; cards, e-money and QR accepted; smoking allowed; 14 seats (counter 8, tables 6); BYO allowed; English and Chinese menus; seasonal seafood, A5 wagyu, Kyoto vegetables, ise-ebi and abalone courses. Reviews (July–September 2026): omakase courses ¥6,600 and ¥8,800; 5 seasonal starters (including fugu-skin jelly); 3 kinds of sashimi; a simmered dish or soup; flounder meunière on the teppan; wagyu steak flambéed in front of you, with wasabi and rock salt; garlic rice and miso soup; fruit or parfait; one says it's more affordable than before.

食べログ (店舗会員の公式情報): 隠 鳥魚、大阪市中央区東心斎橋2-1-13.en: Tabelog (shop member's official info): Kakure Toriuo, Nippo Jumbo Bldg 1F No. 5–6, 2-1-13 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Shinsaibashi and Namba stations; Mon–Sat 17:00–22:30 (L.O. 22:00); closed Sundays; opened 9 April 2018; reservations only; all private rooms (3 sunken-kotatsu rooms, 2 counter rooms); 16 seats; cards accepted, no e-money or QR; heated tobacco only; all-you-can-drink available; an unsigned hideaway; a course of small plates of fish from producers and seasonal vegetables. Reviews (October 2025 – October 2026): the entrance is hard to find; look for the red sign on the Yawata-suji side; a course of many small dishes; fresh fish; chicken dishes; konnyaku and fish roe; good with sake; two wanted a bit more food; budget ¥10,000–20,000.

食べログ (店舗会員の公式情報): 韓国料理コモネ、大阪市中央区千日前1-6-8.en: Tabelog (shop member's official info): Korean Komone, Matoba Bldg B1F, 1-6-8 Sennichimae, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 4 min walk from Namba and Nippombashi stations; 16:00–2:00 next morning (L.O. 1:00); closed Wednesdays; reopened 29 February 2024; reservations accepted; 16 seats; counter; smoking allowed; cards, e-money and PayPay accepted; English and Korean menus; ganjang gejang; ebi kanjang; samgyetang; samgyeopsal; sundubu; nakopsae (for 2, by reservation); Korean drinks (bokbunja, raw makgeolli). Reviews (January 2025 – September 2026): run by two people; ganjang gejang large ¥5,500, small ¥2,700; ganjang saeu large ¥4,050, small ¥2,430; tofu and kimchi jjigae ¥1,200; cheese jeon ¥1,800; rice cake ¥1,300; chadolbagi ¥5,300; samgyetang ¥3,800; pig's trotters ¥1,500; makgeolli ¥1,700 a bottle; bottle keep; yangnyeom gejang comes with gloves; nearly full even at 23:30; one found it ordinary and a little pricey but with good service; one felt as reassured as coming home.

食べログ (店舗会員の公式情報): 鮨 けやき 心斎橋、大阪市中央区西心斎橋1-.en: Tabelog (shop member's official info): Sushi Keyaki Shinsaibashi, Bamboo Alley 2F, 1-9-20 Nishi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3 min walk from Shinsaibashi and Yotsubashi stations; Tue 17:30–22:00, Wed–Sun and holidays 12:00–14:30 and 17:30–22:00 (food L.O. 14:00 and 21:30); closed Mondays; opened 29 November 2014; 8 counter seats; cards (VISA, Master, JCB, Diners) accepted, no e-money or QR; no smoking; fish bought every morning; sake, shochu and wine; official site. Reviews (October 2020 – April 2026): omakase course ¥20,000 (starter, 3 seasonal fish, grilled fish, a dish, chawanmushi, 10 nigiri, miso soup, seasonal fruit); premium sushi course ¥12,000; 3 tiers of dinner course; the lunch course is good value; each piece seasoned with salt, citrus or ume rather than shoyu; salt-crust tuna; kohada; bonito with salt; less rice on request; a 2nd-floor shop with a hard-to-find entrance.
