食べログ: ごま中華 喜界星、大阪市中央区北浜1-3-2 北浜アークビル 1F、.en: Tabelog: Goma Chuka Kikai Boshi, Kitahama Ark Bldg 1F, 1-3-2 Kitahama, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 2 min walk from Sakaisuji Line Kitahama Station, 1 min from Keihan Kitahama Station; next to the FamilyMart right outside exit 30; Tue–Fri and days before holidays 11:30–14:30 (L.O. 14:00) and 18:00–22:00, Sat 11:30–15:00 and 18:00–22:00, Sun 11:30–15:00 (lunch only), holidays 11:30–15:00 and 18:00–22:00; closed Mondays; cards accepted; official site. Reviews (2023 – October 2026): tantanmen of rare Kikaijima sesame; Blend and Aroma 100% (meat miso and chili oil on the side, freshly ground sesame); weekend-and-holiday Three-Star lunch set (half tantanmen, mapo tofu, steamed-chicken salad, almond tofu); tantanmen with 2 dim sum; weekly lunch Singapore chicken rice ¥1,400 (jasmine rice, refills of barley rice, a fiery green-chili paste, soup, pickles, salad, dessert); QR ordering; queues from before noon; booking recommended at weekends; steamed chicken with leek sauce; dim sum; house chili oil; courses; craft lemon squash; an owner with a warm smile; attentive service.

食べログ: さつまラーメン 上六店、大阪市天王寺区上之宮町4-33、近鉄大阪上本.en: Tabelog: Satsuma Ramen Ueroku, 4-33 Uenomiyacho, Tennoji-ku, Osaka; about 7 min from Kintetsu Osaka-Uehommachi Station exit 14; daily 11:00–14:00; no cards, e-money or QR. Reviews (November 2025 – August 2026): an old-style ramen shop in a residential area; busy with students from a nearby high school; student-discount ramen ¥500; ramen set meal ¥850 (rice and kimchi); fried rice set ¥900–950 (ramen and half fried rice); curry fried rice set ¥1,000; service lunch of yakiniku rice bowl and small ramen ¥900; a light, nostalgic tonkotsu; softish medium-thick noodles; one slice of chashu; nori; leek; dipping the fried rice in the soup is recommended; one found it bland; later in the day items may sell out; one says it's a shop of a chain founded in 1951.

食べログ: しあわせのらーめん ミゥ、大阪市中央区森ノ宮中央1-2-21、JR・.en: Tabelog: Shiawase no Ramen Miu, 1-2-21 Morinomiya-chuo, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 2 min walk from JR and subway Morinomiya stations; Mon–Sat 11:00–13:45 (L.O. 13:30); closed Sundays and holidays (sometimes open for events); no cards, e-money or QR; opened 15 September 2013. Reviews (June–October 2026): tonkotsu ramen ¥750; A set (ramen and rice) ¥800; B lunch (ramen and takana rice) ¥850; noodle refill ¥150; chashu-men; a smooth soup strong in pork umami; not too heavy, no lingering aftertaste; medium-thin to medium-thick straight noodles; 3 slices of lean chashu and diced chashu; half a seasoned egg; the pork kamaboko is gone now; run single-handed, return your own dishes; order verbally; served in about 3 minutes; one found the rice soft and sticky; one calls it among the best tonkotsu in Kansai; the smell of tonkotsu on entering; now lunch only; cash only.

食べログ: しじみラーメン Shi43屋 難波店、大阪市中央区難波千日前1-22.en: Tabelog: Shijimi Ramen Shi43ya Namba, Nippo Kawaramachi Kaikan 1F, 1-22 Namba Sennichimae, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 06-6636-4438; no reservations; Tue–Sun and holidays 12:00–15:00 and 20:00–0:30 next morning; closed Mondays; no cards or e-money; 8 seats (counter 6, one table for 2); opened 4 September 2015. 2026 reviews (April–September): the last stop after drinking; cold shijimi and oyster ramen (the shijimi umami is light; stirring in the oyster paste makes it rich); near the now-closed Universe; limited dashi keema maze-soba supervised by the popular curry shop 'Niji no Hotoke'; a shijimi-dashi tare; a regular who has lost count of visits; No. 1 most popular, rich shijimi salt ramen; miso and shoyu too; low-fat and low-calorie with plenty of Yamato shijimi from Lake Shinji, Shimane; shijimi rice with egg; rich shijimi ramen (salt) ¥1,100, large +¥100; one calls it the best shellfish-broth ramen in Namba; at the back of a multi-tenant building, hard to find.

食べログ: しじみラーメン Shi43屋、大阪市中央区心斎橋筋2-2-31 迎賓.en: Tabelog: Shijimi Ramen Shi43ya, Geihinkan Bldg 2F, 2-2-31 Shinsaibashisuji, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 22 seats; Sun–Thu 20:00–5:00, Fri–Sat 20:00–5:30; no cards, e-money or QR payment; no smoking; opened 4 June 2013; private hire on request. Shop introduction: the original recovery ramen, 'rich shijimi ramen', Yamato shijimi clams from Lake Shinji, Shimane Prefecture; salt, miso and shoyu. 2026 reviews (April–August): open until morning; miso; chashu rice bowl; light yet full of shijimi umami; after drinking; one thought shijimi salt ramen at ¥1,200 pricey; a wall covered in celebrity autographs (kabuki actors, Brian May of QUEEN, Yoshimoto comedians, baseball players); 496 kcal; chashu ¥200; salt gyoza ¥400; richness from butter; depth like tonkotsu; reimen (Morioka-reimen-like noodles, 2 slices rare chashu, shijimi, half a seasoned egg, onion, rice crackers); paid in cash.

食べログ: じどりなべ三浦、大阪市中央区東心斎橋1-17-27 日宝ニューコロン.en: Tabelog: Jidori Nabe Miura, Nippo New Columbus Bldg 5F, 1-17-27 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 2–3 min walk from Shinsaibashi Station; Mon–Sat and holidays 17:30–23:00; closed Sundays and holiday Mondays; cards accepted, no e-money or QR; 20 seats (counter 4, 3 tables, 2 of them in a raised sunken-kotatsu area). Reviews (January 2025 – October 2026): a mizutaki specialist; black jidori from Gunma; tender; a rich but not too heavy soup; soft-simmered napa cabbage; grated yam; house yuzu-kosho; finish with soup over rice; zosui; chazuke; peperoncino; tsukune hamburg; chicken prosciutto; chicken sashimi in the Sai course; chicken shabu; staff prepare the hot pot; the smallest Hashi course with chicken ponzu; pasta with lettuce; baguette with chicken prosciutto and cheese; salt-grilled neck; dessert; 3 staff; seen off to the lift; a calm Japanese atmosphere; a building of bars and restaurants; well-paced service.

食べログ: たけくらべ、大阪市中央区難波3-2-14、なんばから188m、月〜金.en: Tabelog: Takekurabe, 3-2-14 Namba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 188 m from Namba; Mon–Fri 11:00–15:00 and 17:00–22:00, Sat–Sun 11:00–22:00; no cards, e-money or QR; 12 seats. Reviews (December 2024 – September 2026): before Yoshimoto Shinkigeki; on the 2nd floor, so no wait if you go off-peak; 11:40 on a Saturday; highball; pork modan-yaki with egg; always the same order; light, doesn't linger; a queue on leaving; extra sauce and mayonnaise available; seats free up quickly if you wait; Take soba (yakisoba wrapped in egg and pressed lightly); spicy or regular sauce; mayonnaise; bonito flakes; slightly flat ramen-like noodles; staff keep an eye on your water; beef-tendon yaki; tatami yakisoba; one was bothered by the service; in without waiting at 18:00 on a weekday; plenty of à la carte dishes too; fluffy batter; beef tendon, leek and egg; pork okonomiyaki; topped with a fried egg; mixed yaki; cooked on the teppan in front of you; near Namba Station.

食べログ: たぶっちゃん、大阪市中央区千日前1-6-1、13席、月〜金17:00.en: Tabelog: Tabucchan, 1-6-1 Sennichimae, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 13 seats; Mon–Fri 17:00–1:00 next morning, Sat 17:00–23:30; closed Sundays and holidays; no cards, e-money or QR payment; smoking allowed; opened 14 June 2014; genre tantanmen, izakaya. 2026 reviews (July–October): a rich, savoury soup; solid heat; large portions; a short queue even on weekdays but fast turnover; shoyu-based; two kinds of tantanmen and many toppings; creamy with a raw egg; street-stall-style shoyu ramen (Sichuan pepper, thin noodles); the owner told a diner that Taiwan, Shanghai and Hong Kong aren't good; Sichuan street-stall tantanmen with cheese ¥1,150; minced meat, nira, bean sprouts; extra coriander and a raw egg; outdoor seats; sharp heat and umami; egg or cheese makes it milder.

食べログ: だしが命の塩らーめん ぎょぎょぎょ なんばパークス店、大阪市浪速区難.en: Tabelog: Dashi ga Inochi no Shio Ramen Gyogyogyo Namba Parks, Namba Parks 6F, 2-10-70 Nambanaka, Naniwa-ku, Osaka; 220 m from Nankai Namba Station; daily 11:00–23:00 (L.O. 22:30); cards and e-money accepted; 36 seats; no smoking; opened 3 April 2021. Reviews (June–October 2026): often not crowded; ordering on table tablets; slow service; prices somewhat high; counter and tables; rich spicy tonkotsu ¥1,000 (frothy soup); want to try the seafood too; the salt ramen of Gyogyogyo, formerly near Namba Shrine in Hommachi; dashi-ga-inochi salt ramen; niboshi black; tonkotsu and karaage set; in front of Parks Cinema; saw it listed as a Michelin Bib Gourmand; thin noodles; one found it less rich than expected; salt ramen with seasoned egg ¥1,250; queues.

食べログ: だしと小麦の可能性、大阪市中央区日本橋2-5-8、近鉄日本橋駅・地下.en: Tabelog: Dashi to Komugi no Kanosei, 2-5-8 Nippombashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 4 min walk from Kintetsu and subway Nippombashi stations; Mon, Wed–Sat and holidays 11:00–14:30 and 17:00–22:00, Sun 11:00–14:30 and 17:00–21:00; closed Tuesdays; no reservations; no cards, e-money or QR; 10 seats (counter 6, tables 4); no smoking; opened 15 October 2021. October 2026 reviews: noodles in frothy kombu water; noodles that marry Japanese and Western; Rosanjin TSUKEMEN ¥1,350, large (300 g) +¥150; a QR code on the table explains how to eat it; kombu water from Rausu kombu; smooth medium-thick flat straight noodles; a salty dipping soup; tororo kombu and prosciutto; at the end, kombu water into the dipping soup; rice-bowl set ¥1,700 from the ticket machine; mini egg-tempura bowl; small-shrimp tempura bowl; a dipping soup strong in shijimi dashi with a Western touch; sudachi; care over the tableware; a popular shop that began as a limited ramen at a katsu-sando shop in Kita-Shinchi; mixed sandwiches; near Kuromon Market; salt ramen too, light yet deep in flavour.

食べログ: ちいかわラーメン 豚 心斎橋、大阪市中央区心斎橋筋1-8-3 心斎橋.en: Tabelog: Chiikawa Ramen Buta Shinsaibashi, Shinsaibashi PARCO B2F, 1-8-3 Shinsaibashisuji, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 06-6484-6311; reservations accepted; daily 11:00–22:00; cards, e-money and QR payment accepted; opened 15 November 2024. October 2026 reviews: arrived 10:45 on a weekday, the lift runs from 11:00; everyone around there for Chiikawa; small ramen; large with extra garlic, regular vegetables, extra fat, stronger flavour; looks Jiro-style; one says it tastes ordinary; one calls it a shop for the collaboration goods; large with no garlic, extra vegetables and fat ¥1,950; a garlic flavour even without garlic; gentler fat than ordinary Jiro-style; shoyu; light; too cute to eat; the drinks are cute too; an hour's wait even with a booking; chewy noodles; the oshibori, chopstick sleeve, bowl, spoon, apron and even the cup are Chiikawa; the mini is the standard amount and even the mini is a lot.

食べログ: つけ麺 ひらの、大阪市東成区東小橋1-1-6、JR玉造駅北口から徒歩.en: Tabelog: Tsukemen Hirano, 1-1-6 Higashi-Obase, Higashinari-ku, Osaka; 2 min walk from JR Tamatsukuri Station north exit; daily 11:00–15:30 and 17:00–22:00; no cards or e-money; PayPay accepted; opened 31 May 2021; official site. Reviews (August–October 2026): pork bones, chicken bones and seafood with fish-flake oil and plenty of back fat; a shoyu dipping soup with a hint of yuzu; house-made thick noodles (about 4.5 mm) with whole wheat, sitting in kombu water; pork-belly chashu; white leek; mizuna; menma; naruto; nori; tsukemen 200 g ¥1,000; spicy tsukemen ¥1,050 (heat 1–3; even 2 is hot); salt tsukemen ¥1,050; special +¥500; large 350 g +¥100; extra-large 400 g +¥200; maze-soba (with rice to finish) ¥1,000; everything-on maze-soba ¥1,500; seasoned egg +¥150; chashu +¥350; ate-menma ¥100; rice ¥250; bottled beer ¥500; yuzu shichimi and black pepper; citrus-scented soup-wari at the counter; mobile ordering; one says you can eat more calmly here than at the popular shop nearby; one wished the dipping soup were stronger.

食べログ: つけ麺 井手、大阪市中央区平野町1-8-5、北浜駅5番出口から徒歩5.en: Tabelog: Tsukemen Ide, 1-8-5 Hiranomachi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Kitahama Station exit 5; Mon–Fri 11:00–15:00 (L.O. 14:30) and 18:00–22:00 (L.O. 21:30), Sat 11:00–15:00; closed Sundays and holidays; temporary closures on social media; cards (including UnionPay) and PayPay accepted; 15 seats (counter 3, tables 12); opened 6 May 2011. October 2026 reviews: glossy, chewy thick noodles; wheat aroma; a rich tonkotsu-seafood dipping soup; not too heavy; chashu and menma; soup-wari; one says medium tsukemen ¥1,450; one calls it ordinary; tsukemen (large) 300 g ¥1,100; strong seafood; full at 13:00 on a weekday, a 5-minute wait; ticket machine; shared tables; tsukemen (regular) ¥1,100; everything-on ¥600; meat-miso rice; ramen apparently at night too; a 10-minute wait after 12:00; medium 250 g; balance of tonkotsu and seafood; shredded-pork rice bowl; curry tsukemen.

食べログ: つけ麺 雀 アメ村本店、大阪市中央区西心斎橋2-11-11、06-6.en: Tabelog: Tsukemen Suzume Amemura main shop, 2-11-11 Nishi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 06-6211-1174; no reservations; daily 11:30–16:30 and 18:00–22:00; open every day of the year (occasional closures); no cards, e-money or QR; 12 seats (counter only); no smoking; opened 2 June 2010; noodles small 200 g or medium 300 g at the same price; official suzume-group.co.jp. 2026 reviews (May–October): niboshi-based yet smooth and deep; after 15 years living in Tokyo, this is still the origin of tsukemen for one diner; about 20% cheaper than Tokyo; spicy tsukemen ¥1,000 at heat 3; change to chili-kneaded noodles +¥30; special spicy tsukemen ¥1,300 (thick chashu); rich and tasty even at heat 2; chewy thick noodles; first mix and eat, then add vinegar and chili oil; a dipping soup rich in seafood umami; a queue in front; a regular of about 15 years says the taste has changed a little.

食べログ: つけ麺 雀 夕陽丘店、大阪市天王寺区生玉寺町2-12、四天王寺前夕陽.en: Tabelog: Tsukemen Suzume Yuhigaoka, 2-12 Ikutamateramachi, Tennoji-ku, Osaka; 306 m from Shitennoji-mae Yuhigaoka Station; daily 11:30–16:30 and 18:00–22:00; no cards, e-money or QR; 33 seats (counter 9, tables 24); sofa seats; no smoking; opened 2 October 2013. Reviews (March 2025 – October 2026): spicy tsukemen ¥1,000, heat 2, 300 g; the dipping soup stays hot; black chuka soba; a little sweet; shichimi and vinegar; a stylish, spacious black-toned interior; counter, tables, sofas; pork bones and mackerel flakes with miso; several chilies; chili oil; a deep-red shrimp dipping soup; chewy medium-thick noodles; thick pork-belly chashu; seasoned egg; nori; choose the noodle amount; yuzu soup-wari; pan-fried gyoza; atsumori; garlic and chili oil; ¥950; a free seasoned egg with the password; often goes to the Amemura shop; ticket machine at the entrance; 200 g or 300 g; heat 1–3; shrimp dashi; seasoned-egg tsukemen; seafood tonkotsu; fish powder; soup-wari.

食べログ: とり料理 とり匠、大阪市中央区東心斎橋1-18-20 アソルティ心斎.en: Tabelog: Tori Ryori Tori Sho, Assorti Shinsaibashi 2F, 1-18-20 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 2 min walk from Shinsaibashi Station exits 5 and 6; Tue–Sun 18:00–0:30 next morning (L.O. 0:00); closed Mondays; table-charge starter ¥500; cards and e-money accepted; 20 seats (counter 8, three tables for 4); private hire up to 20; smoking allowed; opened 11 April 2011. Reviews (October 2023 – June 2026): W Cheese Tsukune; skin crisp outside and fluffy inside; fresh chicken sashimi; kamameshi taking about 40 minutes; lotus-root starter; liver; heart; cucumber; a sweetish sauce; egg on rice to finish; Sapporo Black Beer; friendly staff; a surprise cake arranged; a calm atmosphere.

食べログ: とんかつ みな斗、大阪市中央区島之内2-9-26 1F、日本橋駅から.en: Tabelog: Tonkatsu Minato, 1F, 2-9-26 Shimanouchi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 9 min walk from Nippombashi Station, 10 from Nagahoribashi Station; daily 10:30–14:50 and 17:30–20:50; cards, transit IC, e-money and QR (including Alipay and WeChat Pay) accepted; 10 counter seats; opened 15 May 2024; Instagram. Reviews (April–September 2026): branded-pork tonkatsu; fried at low temperature and well drained; Myojin pork from Mie (hirakatsu 120 g, rib loin 210 g); Hokkaido Dorobuta (loin 175 g ¥5,500, loin and fillet ¥9,900); a rosé cross-section; rock salt; pink salt; wasabi; several sauces; glossy rice; cabbage; seasonal soup (nanohana miso soup in spring, cold dashi with yuba and nyumen in summer, red miso from September); a clean modern Japanese interior with white wood; book on Tabelog; one found it pricey; one wished there were cabbage refills.

食べログ: どうとんぼり神座 なんばウォーク店、大阪市中央区千日前1、毎日10:.en: Tabelog: Dotonbori Kamukura Namba Walk, 1 Sennichimae, Chuo-ku, Osaka; daily 10:00–22:00 (L.O. 21:30); no smoking; cards, e-money and QR payment accepted; opened 13 September 2024; site: the Namba Walk shop page. 2026 reviews: vegetable-laden ramen; garlic and nira on the counter; daytime drinking; limited hot-and-sour noodles (like a light hot-and-sour soup poured over the regular ramen); ramen, karaage and fried rice; spicy-sour noodles with soft-boiled egg; inside the station; ordering on table tablets; medium-thin straight noodles; egg noodles; you can't have fewer noodles but you can have more; sweetness of napa cabbage; shoyu-based; ramen, gyoza, fried rice and draught beer set; fluffy fried rice; a spacious shop.

食べログ: どうとんぼり神座 なんば店、大阪市中央区難波3-2-15、06-66.en: Tabelog: Dotonbori Kamukura Namba, 3-2-15 Namba, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 06-6643-3790; no reservations; Mon–Thu 10:00–23:30, Fri 10:00–24:00, Sat 0:00–1:00 and 10:00–24:00, Sun 0:00–1:00 and 10:00–23:30; no cards or e-money; QR payment accepted; 37 seats; opened 16 September 2021. 2026 reviews (August–October): summer-only cold Oishii Ramen (napa cabbage crisp like pickles; opinions divided); seasoned-egg ramen; under 10 minutes' wait and fast service; opposite Takashimaya, lively with overseas tourists; limited hot-and-sour noodles; Oishii Ramen with plenty of napa cabbage; a queue even before 23:00 on a Friday; half fried rice and gyoza set (fluffy fried rice, garlicky gyoza); a light soup after drinking; chashu-men.

食べログ: どうとんぼり神座 千日前店、大阪市中央区道頓堀1-6-32、なんば駅.en: Tabelog: Dotonbori Kamukura Sennichimae, 1-6-32 Dotonbori, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 289 m from Namba Station; 40 seats; daily 9:00–7:00 next morning; no reservations; official site kamukura.co.jp. 2026 reviews: the Kamukura-versus-Kinryu debate; the first visit to the Sennichimae shop in 3 years; avoided Ichiran's 40-minute wait and came to this shop opposite at 8:50 a.m.; vegetable ramen ¥1,110; can't stop drinking the soup; plenty of cabbage (napa); one noted the napa cabbage tastes bitter in summer; good chashu; a faintly sweet Western-style soup; once a Namba-only shop; karaage and rice set about ¥1,350; cold ume-shiso grated-daikon pork shabu ¥1,250 (ticket machine); strong air conditioning; a gentle light ramen after drinking; ticket machine; one found the young staff glum; a long narrow counter-only shop with one-way flow; the taste differs even within the chain.

食べログ: どうとんぼり神座 心斎橋PARCO店、大阪市中央区心斎橋筋1-8-3.en: Tabelog: Dotonbori Kamukura Shinsaibashi PARCO, Shinsaibashi PARCO B2F, 1-8-3 Shinsaibashisuji, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 06-6121-6456; no reservations; daily 11:00–22:00; until 18:00 on 31 December; closed 1 January; cards and e-money (Edy, iD) accepted, no QR; 24 seats; opened 1 October 2022; official kamukura.co.jp. Reviews (October 2025 – September 2026): Shinsaibashi Neon Shokudo-gai; a line of overseas diners at the ticket machine; simmered-egg ramen (a light consommé-like soup, slightly wavy thin noodles); garlic, doubanjiang and nira on the table for a punchier bowl; soft-boiled simmered egg; about 70% full at 19:00 on a Saturday; prices up but still satisfying; winter limited edition; Oishii Ramen under ¥1,000; chewy thin noodles; plenty of vegetables; busy at lunch but quick turnover.

食べログ: どうとんぼり神座 心斎橋店、大阪市中央区心斎橋筋2-8-26、50席.en: Tabelog: Dotonbori Kamukura Shinsaibashi, 2-8-26 Shinsaibashisuji, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 50 seats (counter only); daily 0:00–6:30 and 10:00–24:00; no smoking; cards and e-money accepted (transit IC, Rakuten Edy, iD); meal-ticket system; official kamukura.co.jp. 2026 reviews (July–September): cold Oishii Ramen (a little salty, because the ice doesn't dilute it); small chashu; plenty of vegetables; first visit in 15 years; seasoned-egg ramen ¥980; sweetness of napa cabbage; light and warming; the cold version is designed so the fat doesn't set; comes with yuzu juice; nearly full even late at night.

食べログ: どうとんぼり神座 戎橋店、大阪市中央区難波3-2-30、67席、月〜.en: Tabelog: Dotonbori Kamukura Ebisubashi, 3-2-30 Namba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 67 seats; Mon–Fri 9:00–23:30, Sat–Sun 0:00–1:00 and 9:00–23:30; no smoking; cards, e-money and QR payment accepted; opened 28 June 2024; official kamukura.co.jp. 2026 reviews: on a shopping-street corner; ordering by touch panel; automatic payment machine; gyoza and beer set; extra-large beer; app points for free toppings; yuzu topping on cold ramen; one mentioned a smell at the ground-floor counter and a dirty fan (August); light, with plenty of napa cabbage; fried rice and karaage set; first visit in 30 years; ramen with lots of vegetables; near NGK; light yet deep in flavour; limited hot-and-sour noodles with coriander; Oishii Ramen; 2 soft-boiled eggs; app coupons.

食べログ: どうとんぼり神座 道頓堀店、大阪市中央区道頓堀1-7-25、なんば駅.en: Tabelog: Dotonbori Kamukura Dotonbori, 1-7-25 Dotonbori, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Namba Station; 71 seats; daily 10:00–8:00 next morning; no reservations; official site kamukura.co.jp. 2026 reviews: a distinctive light soup with napa cabbage; the set is large and filling; one found it too salty; visited thinking it was the main shop; small chashu & simmered-egg ramen ¥1,270 and karaage ¥430 ordered by tablet; savoury-sweet soup and crisp napa cabbage; busy with tourists; side dishes differ by branch; empty beside the queue at Kinryu next door; Oishii Ramen ¥850 and a highball ¥430; a national chain; eaten since student days 35 years ago; secret soup, napa cabbage and thin-sliced pork; many women diners in Osaka; udon-like noodles; seasonal hot-and-sour noodles (Zhenjiang black vinegar, coriander, steamed chicken) and gyoza.

食べログ: どろそば将 堺筋本町店、大阪市中央区淡路町1-6-4、北浜駅5番出口.en: Tabelog: Doro Soba Masa Sakaisuji-Hommachi, 1-6-4 Awajimachi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 4 min walk from Kitahama Station exit 5, 6 min from Sakaisuji-Hommachi Station exit 12; Mon–Sat 11:00–23:00, Sun 11:00–15:00 and 17:00–23:00; irregular closing days; closed 1 January; no cards, e-money or QR; no cover charge; 15 seats (counter 11, one table for 4); opened 15 October 2020. Reviews (August–October 2026): looks rich and heavy but drinks easily; a thick, sludgy soup; smooth, chewy noodles; red pickled ginger for sweetness and a change; lunch set of doro soba with mini chashu rice bowl; strength 2; a potage-like soup of chicken and vegetables simmered until they dissolve; a clean finish; not greasy; thin flat noodles; fried leek and king oyster mushroom; a Nara shop too; ticket machine; kind staff; full on Saturday; spicy doro soba ¥1,500; orange; clings to the noodles; doro tsukemen; big chashu; leek and heat; one says 6 shops at its peak, now only Sakaisuji-Hommachi and Nara; Oni Kyoku doro soba ¥1,600; mini karaage rice bowl ¥100 (lunch); LINE coupons; medium-thick wavy noodles; thin chashu; 2 fried toppings; chili threads; one says the thickness is impressive but the taste ordinary.

食べログ: なにわ 麺次郎、大阪市中央区難波4-1-17 近鉄大阪難波駅 改札内.en: Tabelog: Naniwa Menjiro, inside the ticket gates of Kintetsu Osaka-Namba Station, 4-1-17 Namba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 12 seats (counter); daily 11:00–22:30 (L.O. 22:00); closed third Tuesday; no cards, e-money or QR payment; no smoking; opened 4 July 2019; Tabelog Ramen OSAKA Hyakumeiten 2025; without a commuter pass, buy an entry ticket with service voucher (¥180) at the machine and show it for the same amount off. 2025–2026 reviews: price up to ¥1,150; many overseas diners; special golden shellfish ramen (extra meat and seasoned egg); sweetish, like a shoyu ramen; yuzu and caramelised onion; firm menma; golden shellfish ramen with seared chashu rice bowl ¥1,490 (October 2025); local-chicken shoyu ramen with seasoned egg and seared chashu rice bowl set ¥1,690; cash only; oily but not too strong; rare chashu and pork-belly chashu; mitsuba; a confusing two-step system where the ticket machine issues a QR and you pay at a payment machine; a clear shellfish dashi; an Umeda shop too; small gyoza.

食べログ: なにわの五味八珍ラーメン、大阪市浪速区恵美須東2-6-20 1F、新.en: Tabelog: Naniwa no Gomi Hatchin Ramen, 1F, 2-6-20 Ebisu-higashi, Naniwa-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Shin-Imamiya Station; daily 10:00–4:00 next morning; open every day of the year; cards, e-money and QR accepted; 17 seats (counter 6, tables 11); the back table feels like a hideaway. Reviews (June–September 2026): at the foot of Tsutenkaku; leek ramen ¥1,150 (large ¥1,300; a shoyu base heavy on napa cabbage with chili and garlic, Tenri-ramen style, thin wavy noodles, a mound of leek); regular ramen; spicy ramen; half fried rice ¥300; omu fried rice set; bone-in karaage; Kanazawa curry from Go Go Curry (katsu curry); ticket machine; one found the service curt; open late.

食べログ: なにわ新風 日本橋総本店、大阪市浪速区日本橋5-5-19、恵美須町駅.en: Tabelog: Naniwa Shinpu Nipponbashi head shop, 5-5-19 Nippombashi, Naniwa-ku, Osaka; right by Ebisucho Station exit 2; Mon–Wed and Fri–Sun 18:00–2:00 next morning; closed Thursdays; no cards; no cover charge; 28 seats (counter 8, two tables for 2, four for 4); no smoking 11:00–17:00; smoking area. Reviews (December 2025 – September 2026): shoyu tonkotsu ¥980; sesame miso ¥980 (choose heat); salt chicken-tonkotsu ¥980 (lightly frothy); seafood tonkotsu with thin noodles; seafood tsukemen ¥1,100 (thick noodles, a strong bonito dipping soup); cold bukkake with house chili oil and myoga; abura soba with chashu, menma, egg yolk and shredded nori; spend over a set amount for a free croquette, fried shumai, karaage or gyoza; queues late at night; a bowl after drinking.

食べログ: なみ一 (旧店名 七三一)、大阪市中央区難波千日前7-4、南海なんば.en: Tabelog: Nami Ichi (formerly Shichisanichi), 7-4 Namba Sennichimae, Chuo-ku, Osaka; about 5 min walk from Nankai Namba Station; Mon, Tue and Thu 10:30–15:00, Fri–Sat 10:30–20:00, Sun and holidays 10:30–17:00; closed Wednesdays; set meals at lunch, a soba shop at night; cards and QR accepted, no e-money; no smoking; 9 seats; official site. Reviews (April–October 2026): founded 2000; a Showa-retro shop down an Ura-Namba alley; hand-made soba; grilled-duck soba with Kujo leek; duck nanban soba set meal ¥1,800; duck rice bowl and small soba set ¥1,800; eel mixed rice and small soba ¥2,100; free refills of clay-pot mixed rice; house pickles; unlimited tenkasu; finish with soba broth or tea poured over; queues at weekend lunch; sister shop 'Namiichi Seven'; photo captions say 'light mixed rice, freshly cooked' and 'plenty of house-made pickles too'; one found ¥1,800 pricey for a casual lunch.

食べログ: にほん酒や一路、大阪市中央区東心斎橋2-7-12 ホワイトビル302.en: Tabelog: Nihonshu-ya Ichiro, White Bldg 302, 2-7-12 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; Mon–Fri 19:00–2:00 next morning, Sat–Sun 14:00–24:00; irregular closing days; QR accepted, no cards or e-money; 10 seats (standing when full); smoking allowed; opened 27 November 2015. Reviews (October 2025 – October 2026): 3rd floor of the White Bldg, between Tatamiyamachi and Kasayamachi; counter by the entrance, tables at the back; baseball on TV; Heartland bottled beer; a range of sake; firefly squid and pumpkin tempura; Sake Day; simmered tamahimo; chashu; a limited Kujiranami sake; simmered Saga beef offal; tripe; 4 diners already in at 15:00 on a holiday; horse racing on TV; Ishizuchi; simmered sardines with Utsukushihime; regulars and overseas diners; the owner says weekdays are regulars and weekends mostly overseas visitors; sake ¥800–1,000; about one go in a masu; whisky too; opens 14:00 on weekends and holidays; a door you can't see through makes it hard to enter; a warm welcome; good value; a superb selection.

食べログ: にんにくらーめん 天洋 新町店、大阪市西区新町1-29-8、西大橋駅.en: Tabelog: Ninniku Ramen Tenyo Shinmachi, 1-29-8 Shinmachi, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 1 min walk from Nishi-Ohashi Station exit 2; Mon–Sat 11:00–15:00 and 17:00–23:00; closed Sundays; QR (PayPay, Alipay) accepted, no cards or e-money; 22 seats (counter 10, tables 12); no smoking; opened 22 April 2021. Reviews (June–October 2026): spicy miso K ramen ¥1,100 with garlic; usually the miso ramen; the miso without garlic is ordinary; freshly cooked rice and the famous takana; kimchi; spacious, clean inside; miso garlic ramen; tonkotsu base; wavy noodles; strongly seasoned chashu; set meals too; Kyoto Kujo Negi ramen; less garlic; garlic miso chashu-men; extra garlic can come on a separate plate; extra leek costs more; boiled egg; mellow miso; rich tonkotsu; ¥900; drank all the soup.

食べログ: にんにくらーめん 麦吉、大阪市西区立売堀3-7-13、阿波座駅から3.en: Tabelog: Ninniku Ramen Mugiyoshi, 3-7-13 Itachibori, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 301 m from Awaza Station; Mon–Fri 11:00–15:00 and 17:00–0:30 next morning, Sat, Sun and holidays 11:00–0:30 next morning; closures on social media; opened 7 January 2024; PayPay accepted, no cards; children and pushchairs welcome. Reviews (January 2024 – October 2026): on Amidaike-suji; a bright, clean, spacious shop; ticket machine; asked how much garlic (less, regular, more); tonkotsu shoyu ramen ¥950 (mellow and creamy); miso ramen; garlic shoyu ramen; medium-thin wavy noodles; thick pork-belly chashu; chashu-men; seasoned egg ¥120; bean sprouts; half fried rice set with kimchi ¥350; gyoza and rice set ¥1,250; free rice and pickles at lunch; earlier some found the soup thin, but in July 2026 one found it just right; open late.

食べログ: のの屋、大阪市中央区千日前1-6-6、日本橋駅から徒歩3分、火〜日1.en: Tabelog: Nono Ya, 1-6-6 Sennichimae, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3 min walk from Nippombashi Station; Tue–Sun 18:00–24:00; closed Mondays; opened 5 June 2019; reservations accepted; seat charge ¥250; cards AMEX only, no e-money or QR; smoking allowed; 16 seats (counter 8, tatami private room 8); chicken yakiniku of Tajima chicken over charcoal; hot pots and courses too. Reviews (December 2023 – May 2025): grill it yourself at the table; neck, thigh, skin, old hen, the heart cut 'kokoro no kori'; chicken sashimi platter; liver sashimi; chicken sashimi with grated yam; thigh tataki; chicken nanban; salt-stir-fried liver; chicken tempura; leek salad; chicken, potato and cheese; chicken hot pot and chicken shabu-shabu; bean-sprout namul; omelette; chat with staff at the counter; the tatami room at the back fills with bookings; lots of smoke, mind your clothes; two entrances.

食べログ: びじねす食堂、大阪市北区中之島3-2-30 MINAMO B1F、京.en: Tabelog: Business Shokudo, MINAMO B1F, 3-2-30 Nakanoshima, Kita-ku, Osaka; directly connected to Keihan Watanabebashi Station; Mon–Fri 11:00–15:00 and 18:00–22:00; closed weekends; cards, e-money and QR accepted; 12 seats (counter 4, tables); opened 20 June 2018. Reviews (June–September 2026): maze-soba (original, shoyu, Sichuan, sea-bream salt); 100–500 g; garlic or not; heat level; with rice at lunch; staff recommend the sea-bream salt cold; Exquisite shoyu ramen (medium-thin straight noodles, 3 slices chashu, thick menma, wontons); blended shoyu ramen; sweetish tori-paitan ramen; Nakanoshima black ramen; tori-paitan tsukemen; spicy tsukemen; sweet and spicy tantanmen; seasonal stamina ramen and cold tsukemen (order verbally); ramen in regular and DX; ticket machine to the right of the entrance; queues at lunch; one found the maze-soba sweetish and not hot even at heat 3.

食べログ: ふら～っと。カレー家、大阪市浪速区稲荷1-7-30、JR難波駅から約.en: Tabelog: Fura~tto. Curry Ya, 1-7-30 Inari, Naniwa-ku, Osaka; about 10 min from JR Namba Station; Mon and Thu–Sat 11:30–21:00, Tue–Wed 11:30–17:00 (L.O. 16:00); closed Sundays and holidays; closes in the evening when the rice runs out; no cards; PayPay and d-barai accepted; smoking allowed; 13 seats. Reviews (April–September 2026): a small shop on a quiet street; open past lunchtime; chicken-katsu curry ¥980 (crisp, tender chicken-breast katsu; a mild European-style curry sweet with onion); spicy curry too; one found too little roux for the rice; run single-handed at busy times, so sometimes a wait; a tobacco smell; hot inside in summer; a warm atmosphere.

食べログ: ぼっかけや、大阪市西区新町1-2-13 新町ビル 1F、四ツ橋駅北1.en: Tabelog: Bokkake Ya, Shinmachi Bldg 1F, 1-2-13 Shinmachi, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 3 min walk from Yotsubashi Station north exit 1A and Hommachi Station; Mon–Sat 11:30–14:30 (L.O. food 14:00) and 17:30–22:00 (L.O. food 21:30), until 21:30 on holidays; closed Sundays; holiday closures on Tabelog or Instagram; cards and PayPay accepted; 20 seats (counter 5). Reviews (2008 – October 2026): a small soba shop busy at lunch, a soba izakaya at night; thin, fragrant juwari soba, good even with salt; bokkake soba; Iso Karami Soba (seaweed, sudachi, spicy grated daikon); cold oroshi bukkake (very spicy grated daikon); Yamato Tororo Soba ¥1,450; walnut soba; at lunch a set of soba with miso tendon (burdock tempura); nozawana rice balls; at night a 5-small-dish platter; dashi omelette; beans; salt-grilled iwana; omakase sake snacks; courses; sakes such as Daishinshu and Igarashi; Yona Yona Ale; a cramped counter.

食べログ: ぼてぢゅう本店 道頓堀、大阪市中央区道頓堀1-6-15 Comrad.en: Tabelog: Botejyu main shop Dotonbori, Comrade Doton Bldg 2F, 1-6-15 Dotonbori, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 94 seats (live teppan counter 10, counter 8, 18 tables with 76 seats); daily 11:00–1:00 next morning; no smoking; cards and e-money accepted; features: vegan menu. Shop introduction: okonomiyaki and mayonnaise handed down for over 78 years since the founding; the original modan-yaki. 2026 reviews (August–October): half the diners from overseas; menu in about 4 languages; dishes cooked elsewhere are brought to the teppan seats; rich and strong-flavoured; large portions; modan-yaki, Akashi-yaki, Kaku highball; staff from overseas too; modan-yaki ¥1,850 (pork, shrimp, squid); cheese-tama (potato, mentaiko sauce) ¥1,350; sweet sauce and mayonnaise; edamame in garlic oil; garlic rice; one says it differs from the Botejyu in Namba; prices have gone up.

食べログ: まぜそば 寿寿寿、大阪市西成区萩之茶屋1-2-24、新今宮から34m.en: Tabelog: Mazesoba Jujuju, 1-2-24 Haginochaya, Nishinari-ku, Osaka; 34 m from Shin-Imamiya; daily 11:00–23:00; cards (VISA, Master), transit IC, e-money and QR accepted; opened 25 October 2022. Reviews (July–October 2026): one found it hard to feed cash into the ticket machine; one calls the taste ordinary; one says the closing rice was yellowed; close to the station; rice offer; right by the Nankai Shin-Imamiya Station gate; the chuka ramen is a nostalgic shoyu (chashu, menma, leek, nori); children's plates and cups; counter and tables; the popular one is the seafood maze-soba of tonkotsu and seafood; one says the noodles are 'Jumian', once made for celebrations by an old Shin-Imamiya noodle maker; karaage; gyoza; Taiwan maze-soba; seafood-dashi maze-soba regular ¥900, large +¥100; boiled egg; menma; diced chashu; fish powder; leek; chewy noodles; one wanted more seafood; chili oil and shichimi on the table; a new, clean shop; ticket machine; choose with or without rice (default is without); a sweetish sauce; plenty of noodles; change the flavour with kombu vinegar and chili oil.

食べログ: まほろば囲炉裏 心斎橋、大阪市中央区東心斎橋1-16-32 BE'S.en: Tabelog: Mahoroba Irori Shinsaibashi, BE'S50 Bldg 1F, 1-16-32 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3 min walk from Shinsaibashi Station; Mon–Sat and holidays 18:00–24:00 (food L.O. 23:00); closed Sundays; starter ¥1,000; cards accepted, no e-money or QR; heated tobacco only; 16 seats; private room; à la carte changes with season and supply. Reviews (July–August 2026): an irori restaurant down a Shinsaibashi back alley; Kishu binchotan, so little smoke or smell; a seasonal course (small fish, big shellfish, live lobster and abalone, wagyu, wild boar, duck, vegetables); charcoal-grilled in front of you; one says you grill it yourself; wagyu scented with XO sauce; thick-cut wagyu sirloin rice bowl; honey before the meal; told of a disliked ingredient, staff made abalone-liver sauce on the spot; budget ¥20,000–30,000.

食べログ: まんかい 天満橋店、大阪市中央区谷町1-5-9、天満橋駅4番出口から.en: Tabelog: Mankai Tenmabashi, 1-5-9 Tanimachi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 1 min walk from Tenmabashi Station exit 4; Mon, Wed and Sat 11:00–23:00, Thu–Fri 11:00–16:00 and 17:30–23:00, Sun and holidays 11:00–22:00; closed Tuesdays and over New Year; no cards, e-money or QR; 17 seats (counter 8, tables 9); opened 29 July 2015; official site. Reviews (2024–2026): Hakata Junkei Tonkotsu Ramen; Jun Ton with seasoned egg ¥1,130; a soup without off-smell from pig's head bones, knuckles, backbones and back fat boiled 15 hours; extra-thin straight low-hydration noodles; bari-kata; belly and leg chashu; wood-ear; Tomaton (tomato tonkotsu) with rice ¥1,250; ¥1,400 with seasoned egg and rice; in 2024 Tomaton ¥1,050 and rice ¥200; spicy tomato sauce; garlic; like a soup pasta; one called it ordinary; salt tonkotsu; half noodle refill ¥140; unlimited spicy takana (some days not on the table, had to ask); ground sesame; red pickled ginger; ticket machine inside; a big shared table.

食べログ: まんまる食堂、大阪市中央区道頓堀1-7-10 日宝バイストリート横丁.en: Tabelog: Manmaru Shokudo, Nippo By-Street Yokocho Bldg, 1-7-10 Dotonbori, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from subway Namba Station exit 16; Fri 17:30–22:30, Sat and days before holidays 15:30–22:30, Sun and holidays 15:30–21:00; closed Mon–Thu and the day after holidays (the same page also says 'open every day of the year'); reservations accepted, with the special 7-dish course ¥3,000 (before tax) recommended; cards, e-money and QR accepted; smoking allowed; 14 seats (counter 8, tables 4–6); opened 24 April 2015. Reviews (March–September 2026): dishes built on study of the basic seasonings, neither authentic Sichuan nor neighbourhood Chinese; chatting with the owner at a round counter; stir-fried green pepper and pork; black-vinegar sweet-and-sour pork; mapo tofu; mouth-watering chicken; stir-fried water spinach; Sichuan mapo potatoes with seared cheese; scallion-oil noodles; a Chinese tavern at the far end of Hozenji Yokocho; about 10 counter seats and one table for 4; run by a married couple; booking recommended, and hard to find; nira-and-egg rice bowl; homely, the owner smiling; Hakata-style nira and egg (with takana); spicy la zi ji (peanuts, coriander); look for the shop's sign rather than the building name; cumin pork skewers; fried horse mackerel.

食べログ: みな都、大阪市中央区東心斎橋1-15-25 リッツビル 1F、心斎橋.en: Tabelog: Minato, Ritz Bldg 1F, 1-15-25 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Shinsaibashi and Nagahoribashi stations; Tue–Sat 17:30–22:00 (L.O. 21:00); closed Sundays and Mondays; opened 1 October 1999; starter ¥500 (none with courses); cards accepted, no e-money or QR; no smoking; 15 seats (counter 7, 2 tables); primary-school age and up; no sandals or shorts; loud voices and strong fragrances please refrain; first-visit discount for registering on LINE; proud of its dashi; sashimi of fish, crab, sea urchin, abalone, Yamagata beef, whale and horse; Rosanjin-style tableware; 4 courses and about 70 à la carte dishes; over 12 sakes. Reviews (August 2023 – June 2026): Kumamoto horse sashimi; abalone liver; steamed abalone; crab miso and crab; grilled sesame tofu; salt-grilled ayu; white fish fried with its scales; aubergine and yuba in ginger sauce; lotus-root manju; tempura rice ball; sea-bream chazuke with sesame sauce; warm duck soba; no prices shown for à la carte; one says about ¥16,000 per person.

食べログ: みな麺 なんばウォーク店、大阪市中央区難波2丁目 なんばウォーク1番.en: Tabelog: Minamen Namba Walk, 1-bangai Kita-dori, Namba Walk, 2-chome Namba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 14 seats; daily 11:00–22:00 (L.O. 21:30); 2026 closing days 1/1, 1/21, 3/18, 5/20, 7/15, 9/16, 11/18 (third Wednesday of odd months, second Wednesday in March); until 18:00 on 12/31 and 20:00 on 1/2; no smoking (use the facility's smoking area); cards and e-money accepted; opened 14 April 2023. Shop introduction: the first shop of the next brand from the queue-famous 'Jinrui Mina Menrui'; shoyu ramen made only from 'water and shoyu', without dashi. 2026 reviews (September–October): ice-cold noodles ¥970 (thin straight noodles, 3 slices chicken breast, chili oil, bonito soup); seared chashu rice bowl ¥330; special shoyu ramen; an explosion of umami in a clear soup; low-temperature chashu; pay at the entrance; clear shoyu ramen ¥990; free rice refills; with the special or premium topping a half noodle refill is free; whole-wheat noodles; rare chashu; chicken chashu; one says the bowl is only about half full.

食べログ: むかいの 五八、大阪市中央区東心斎橋1-6-23 清水町会館 3F、.en: Tabelog: Mukaino Gohachi, Shimizumachi Kaikan 3F, 1-6-23 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 4 min walk from Nagahoribashi Station; from 18:00; irregular closing days; reservations only (same-day bookings OK; seat-only bookings not accepted); yakitori course ¥3,500; drinks ¥400–700; no cards, e-money or QR; 12 counter seats; opened 1 October 2020. Reviews (April–September 2026): a hideaway in a quiet corner of the building; simple seasoning that lets the ingredients speak; an owner easy to talk to; cheese and quail-egg tsukune; grilled rice balls; the sign is hard to see; turn left out of the lift; course only; grilled at the pace you eat; potato salad; reasonably priced drinks; cooked on a teppan for each group; on full days one person runs it, so drinks are slow; large portions; Gohachi in the building opposite; yakitori grilled on a teppan; 3 sauces and salt; about ¥4,000 each; from 2 people (unconfirmed, one says).

食べログ: もんじゃ 麦、大阪市中央区東心斎橋1-17-1 コスミビル 2F、心.en: Tabelog: Monja Mugi, Cosmi Bldg 2F, 1-17-1 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3 min walk from Shinsaibashi Station, 5 from Nagahoribashi Station; Mon–Thu 17:00–2:00 next morning, Fri–Sat 17:00–5:00 next morning, Sun 17:00–24:00; irregular closing days; cards and PayPay accepted, no e-money; 16 seats; private hire up to 20; smoking allowed. Reviews (February 2025 – September 2026): monja based on the taste of Tsukishima, Tokyo; a batter rich in dashi; Mugi Special; Mentai Mochi Cheese; Mentaiko; Yuzu Kosho; gratin; Komtang, Chicken Ramen and Shin Ramyeon monja; toppings of chikuwa, corn, Baby Star and egg yolk; tonpei-yaki; okonomiyaki; yakisoba; avocado sashimi; cucumber; staff cook it in front of you; a lively atmosphere.

食べログ: やき亭ぼーの、大阪市中央区心斎橋筋2-3-5 日宝ファインプラザビル.en: Tabelog: Yakitei Bono, Nippo Fine Plaza Bldg 1F, 2-3-5 Shinsaibashisuji, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 06-6211-5933; reservations accepted; Mon–Sat 18:00–23:00 (closes when sold out); closed Sundays (open on a Sunday before a holiday); irregular closing days (twice a month); no cards or e-money; QR accepted; 14 seats (counter 8, tables). Reviews (2025–2026): superb duck sashimi, comparing cuts; ¥5,500 course; yakitori; potato salad; grilled vegetables; the highball is weak but there are many Japanese whiskies; a hideaway on the ground floor of a multi-tenant building north of Dotonbori; charcoal yakitori of Yamato chicken and duck; 5 kinds of duck sashimi and 5 yakitori for ¥3,300; dashimaki; chicken liver; Kawachi duck, Yamato chicken, Yamagata pork; raw duck liver; chicken sashimi limited, book in advance; wine; a kind owner; the owner runs it single-handed; negima and skin; still superb in August 2026, one says; Kawachi duck and yakitori on skewers; fresh chicken sashimi.

食べログ: らぁめん しゅき、大阪市東成区東小橋3-14-10、鶴橋駅から徒歩2.en: Tabelog: Raa-men Shuki, 3-14-10 Higashi-Obase, Higashinari-ku, Osaka; 2 min walk from Tsuruhashi Station; Mon–Fri 11:00–15:00 and 18:00–0:30 next morning, Sat–Sun 11:00–0:30 next morning; cards, e-money and QR (including Alipay and WeChat Pay) accepted; 11 seats (counter 7, one table for 4); opened 10 June 2020. Reviews (August 2025 – October 2026): tori-paitan shoyu and salt; rich yet clean; the light salt ramen is clear-tasting; special shoyu ramen; the shoyu tsukemen is sharp and salty; one rates it among the top 3 tsukemen in Japan; seasonal cold editions (autumn sanma and mushroom cold ramen ¥1,580: dashi of Rausu kombu, sanma flakes and dried shiitake; fried enoki, maitake tempura, simmered shimeji and shiitake, chicken chashu, shredded white leek, mitsuba, yuzu); seasoned egg ¥150; raw egg; nori; salt-tare chicken starter with bottled beer; free kimchi; a short queue at lunch.

食べログ: らぁ麺 はやし田 道頓堀店、大阪市中央区道頓堀1-10-1 道頓堀観.en: Tabelog: Raa-men Hayashida Dotonbori, Dotonbori Kanko Bldg B1F, 1-10-1 Dotonbori, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 16 seats (counter); daily 11:00–23:00; no reservations; opened 11 February 2022; official site ramenings.com. 2026 reviews: under the Glico sign; summer-only yuzu-scented cold ramen ¥950 (yuzu jelly); the kamatama is discontinued; a soup of duck and 'Daisendori' chicken; special tsukemen ¥1,250, large +¥150, red-yolk oyakodon ¥350; a clear soup; a brand of INGS Co. (Shinjuku), its first franchise in Kansai; shoyu ramen ¥900 (pork-shoulder and chicken-breast chashu, menma, leek); special shoyu ¥1,200 (firm thin whole-wheat noodles, a 'Maximum Koitama' seasoned egg, chicken chashu); TKG; tori paitan (like a potage); ticket machine; cold ramen with oyakodon ¥400; rare chashu; a kind owner; light; avoiding the lunchtime queue; maze-soba and an egg with truffle sauce.

食べログ: らーめん まぜそば あらし 東心斎橋店、大阪市中央区東心斎橋2-5-.en: Tabelog: Ramen Mazesoba Arashi Higashi-Shinsaibashi, 2-5-16 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; listed as daily 12:00–7:00 next morning (L.O. 6:30); no smoking; listed as accepting cards and QR payment; opened 1 October 2026. 食べログ: らーめん 兆、大阪市中央区平野町2-5-14、淀屋橋駅から徒歩約6分.en: Tabelog: Ramen Cho, 2-5-14 Hiranomachi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; about 6 min walk from Yodoyabashi Station, 5 from Kitahama Station; Mon–Sat 11:00–23:00; closed Sundays and holidays; no cards, e-money or QR; 22 seats (ground-floor counter 4, 2nd-floor tables 18). 食べログ: らーめん 吉山商店 なんばラーメン一座店、大阪市中央区難波3-2-1.en: Tabelog: Ramen Yoshiyama Shoten Namba Ramen Ichiza, Edion Namba main store 9F, 3-2-18 Namba, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 06-6536-8440; no reservations; daily 11:00–22:30; cards accepted, no e-money or QR; no smoking; opened 7 June 2019; official yosiyama-shouten.com. 2026 reviews (February–October): roasted-sesame miso ramen ¥1,150; leek chashu mayo rice bowl ¥400; Sapporo-style wavy noodles; thick chashu; rich seafood roasted-sesame miso ¥1,030 (nori, menma, leek, half a seasoned egg); limited cold abura soba ¥950 and leek-meat rice bowl ¥350; roasted-sesame miso premium pork-belly chashu-men; yellow medium-thick wavy noodles; wood-ear; piping-hot soup; the aroma of sesame; a strong miso yet a light finish; a soup with seafood; one found the miso too strong.
